remote.pilotIntro.english: Operate your station from an approved browser. The shack PC keeps the radio and stays in charge: what you click and type here goes to the station, and this page shows what the station reports back.
remote.pilotIntro.chinese: 在已批准的浏览器中操作你的电台。本地电台室的电脑连接着电台并保留控制权：你在此处点击或输入的内容会发送到电台，此页面则显示电台返回的信息。
remote.pilotIntro.machine: 从一个经批准的浏览器操作您的站台 。 棚式PC保持收音机并保持主控状态:你点击这里并打到台上的内容,本页显示台上的报告内容.

remote.signedOutPitch.english: Operate your station from any browser you approve, while the radio stays at the shack.
remote.signedOutPitch.chinese: 通过你批准的任意浏览器操作电台，电台仍连接在本地电台室的电脑上。

remote.signUpHint.english: New here? Create an account, then enter the six-digit code we email you. After that you are signed in.
remote.signUpHint.chinese: 首次使用？创建账号，然后输入通过电子邮件发送给你的六位数验证码。完成后即可登录。
remote.signUpHint.machine: 新来的? 创建一个账户,然后输入我们通过电子邮件发送的六位数代码。 之后,你被签入。

remote.notConfigured.english: The Remote service has not been configured yet.

remote.loggingLocalHint.english: Approving a browser also lets it log contacts. To limit a browser, revoke logging here. Logging never grants radio or transmit control.
remote.loggingLocalHint.chinese: 批准浏览器后，该浏览器也可以记录交信。如需限制其权限，请在此撤销日志记录权限。此权限不会授予电台控制权或发射权限。
remote.loggingLocalHint.machine: 批准浏览器也允许它登录联系人. 要限制浏览器, 在此取消日志 。 伐木从来不给予无线电或传输控制。

remote.loggingTakeOver.english: End remote logging: everyone off until Remote is turned on again
remote.loggingTakeOver.chinese: 结束远程日志记录：所有浏览器立即断开，直到再次开启远程功能

remote.controlRequestFailed.english: The command was not confirmed. Check station control permission and the current readings.
remote.controlRequestFailed.chinese: 未能确认命令已执行。请检查电台控制权限和当前读数。

remote.controlLocalHint.english: Approving a browser gives it station controls: supported receiver, radio and amplifier controls, and Stop TX, which stops any transmission at the station. With streaming on, they also let it stream this window and use Nexus as you would here, transmit included. To limit a browser, revoke them here, which also ends its stream.
remote.controlLocalHint.chinese: 批准浏览器后，它可以控制受支持的接收机、电台和功放，也可以使用 Stop TX 停止电台上的任何发射。开启画面串流后，浏览器还可以串流此窗口并像本地一样使用 Nexus，包括发射。如需限制浏览器权限，请在此撤销授权；撤销后该浏览器的串流也会结束。
remote.controlLocalHint.machine: 批准一个浏览器会给予它站台控制:支持的接收器,无线电和放大器控制,以及停止TX,它会停止在站台的任何传输. 随着流线的展开,他们也让它流这个窗口 并使用Nexus,在这里,包括传输。 要限制浏览器,请在此取消它们,它也会结束它的流.

remote.b1.rotatorPointing.chinese: 正在将天线旋转器转向 {{call}}。

remote.transmitAllow.english: Allow FT8/FT4 transmission from the Remote page
remote.transmitAllow.chinese: 允许从远程页面进行 FT8/FT4 发射

remote.transmitRevoke.english: Revoke FT8/FT4 transmission from the Remote page
remote.transmitRevoke.chinese: 撤销从远程页面进行 FT8/FT4 发射的权限

remote.transmitLocalHint.english: FT8/FT4 transmit from the Remote page also needs station controls. Once allowed, it stays allowed across restarts until you revoke it here, and revoking it stops that browser’s FT8/FT4 transmission from the page at once. Nothing transmits from the page until the browser presses TX On. A streaming browser doesn’t need it: through the stream it transmits as you would here.
remote.transmitLocalHint.chinese: 从 Remote 页面进行 FT8/FT4 发射还需要电台控制权限。获准后，此权限在 Nexus 重启后仍有效，直到你在此撤销。撤销后，该浏览器会立即失去从页面进行 FT8/FT4 发射的权限。浏览器必须按下 TX On 才会从页面发射。通过画面串流操作的浏览器不需要此单独权限；串流中的发射与本地操作相同。
remote.transmitLocalHint.machine: FT8/FT4 从远程页面传输也需要站台控制。 一旦被允许,它会一直被允许在重启之前,直到您取消它,并取消它停止浏览器 FT8/FT4 即刻从页面传送. 在浏览器按下 TX On 之前,没有从页面发送任何信息。 流线浏览器不需要它: 通过流线, 它会按您在此发送 。

remote.controlTakeOver.english: End remote control: everyone off until Remote is turned on again
remote.controlTakeOver.chinese: 结束远程控制：所有浏览器立即断开，直到再次开启远程功能

remote.loggingController.chinese: 此浏览器正在控制远程日志记录。

remote.requestFailed.english: The request could not be completed. Check the connection and your service access, then try again.
remote.requestFailed.chinese: 无法完成请求。请检查网络连接和服务访问权限，然后重试。

remote.accountMatch.english: Match this account ID on both screens:
remote.accountMatch.chinese: 请核对两个屏幕上显示的账号 ID：

remote.trialNotStarted.english: Your account is ready. Pair a station from the shack — approving it at the radio starts the fourteen days.
remote.trialNotStarted.chinese: 账号已准备就绪。请在电台室为电台配对；在电台上批准配对后，14 天试用期即开始。
remote.trialNotStarted.machine: 你的账户准备好了 从棚子里给一个电台配对——在无线电台上批准它开始14天.

remote.trialRunning.english: Trial access is running. Days remaining: {{days}}. Started {{from}}, ends {{until}} UTC.
remote.trialRunning.chinese: 试用权限已启用。剩余 {{days}} 天。开始于 {{from}}，将于 {{until}} UTC 到期。

remote.trialUnknownStart.english: Trial access is running until {{until}} UTC. This account predates the trial clock, so its start date is not recorded.
remote.trialUnknownStart.chinese: 试用访问权限有效至 {{until}} UTC。此账号创建早于试用期计时功能，因此没有记录开始日期。
remote.trialUnknownStart.machine: 审判权限一直持续到{{until}} UTC。该账户早于试验时间,因此其起始日期没有记录。

remote.trialEnded.english: Your trial ended {{until}} UTC. Nothing at your station has changed — Nexus on your PC is unaffected.
remote.trialEnded.chinese: 你的试用期已于 {{until}} UTC 结束。电台上的设置没有变化，你电脑上的 Nexus 不受影响。
remote.trialEnded.machine: 你的审判结束了{{until}} UTC您的站台上没有任何变化 —— 您的PC上的Nexus没有受到影响 。

remote.confirmAttachPrompt.english: Attach “{{station}}” to your account? Approving at the radio starts your 14-day trial, and it can only be started once.
remote.confirmAttachPrompt.chinese: 要将“{{station}}”关联到你的账号吗？在电台上批准后，14 天试用期即开始，而且只能开始一次。
remote.confirmAttachPrompt.machine: 附录“{{station}}"你的账户? 在电台的核准开始你14天的试播 只能开始一次

remote.confirmAttachWarning.english: Only continue if this code came from your own copy of Nexus. A code somebody sent you attaches their station, not yours.
remote.confirmAttachWarning.chinese: 只有在此代码来自你自己的 Nexus 实例时才继续。别人发给你的代码会将对方的电台关联到你的账号，而不是你的电台。
remote.confirmAttachWarning.machine: 只有这个代码来自你自己的Nexus副本时,才能继续. 密码是有人寄给你的 不是你的

remote.trialDisabled.english: Service access for this account has been switched off. This is not the same as the trial running out.
remote.trialDisabled.chinese: 此账号的服务访问权限已被关闭。这与试用期到期不同。
remote.trialDisabled.machine: 此账户的服务访问已关闭 。 这和审判结束不一样

remote.lanFree.english: Remote on the shack's own network stays free: Stream and Listen work when this device is on the same network as the station.
remote.lanFree.chinese: 在电台室本地网络中使用远程功能仍然免费：此设备与电台处于同一网络时，可以使用“串流”和“收听”。
remote.lanFree.machine: 在棚子本身的网络上的远程保持免费:当这个设备与站台在同一网络上时,Stream和Listen工作.

remote.askAboutAccess.english: Ask about access in the beta channel
remote.askAboutAccess.chinese: 请在 Beta 频道咨询访问权限

remote.stationLimitReached.english: This account already has two stations. Revoke one you are not using before pairing another.
remote.stationLimitReached.chinese: 此账号已关联两台电台。请先撤销一台暂不使用的电台，再进行配对。

remote.pairingExpired.english: That pairing code has expired or has already been used. Get a fresh one from Nexus at the shack.
remote.pairingExpired.chinese: 配对码已过期或已使用。请在电台室的 Nexus 中重新生成配对码。

remote.pairingCodeMalformed.english: A pairing code is sixteen characters, digits 0-9 and letters a-f only. Check for a letter O where a zero should be.
remote.pairingCodeMalformed.chinese: 配对码由 16 个字符组成，只能包含数字 0–9 和字母 a–f。请注意不要把数字 0 看成字母 O。
remote.pairingCodeMalformed.machine: 配对代码是十六个字符,数字为0-9,只有字母a-f. 请检查access-date=中的日期值 (帮助)

remote.deviceLimitReached.english: This station already has as many approved browsers as it allows. Forget one you no longer use, then try again.
remote.deviceLimitReached.chinese: 此电台已达到可批准的浏览器数量上限。请先移除一个不再使用的浏览器，然后重试。
remote.deviceLimitReached.machine: 这个站已经拥有尽可能多的批准浏览器. 别管你用过的了 再试一次

remote.signInAgain.english: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to carry on.
remote.signInAgain.chinese: 登录已过期。请重新登录以继续。

remote.signInRefused.english: Sign-in was refused. If you have just created an account, confirm your email with the code or link we sent, then sign in again.
remote.signInRefused.chinese: 登录被拒绝。如果你刚创建账号，请使用我们发送的代码或链接确认邮箱，然后重新登录。
remote.signInRefused.machine: 签字被拒绝。 如果您刚刚创建了账户, 请用我们发送的代码或链接确认您的电子邮件, 然后再次签名 。

remote.confirmEmailTitle.chinese: 请确认邮箱以完成操作

remote.confirmEmailBody.english: Your sign-up worked, but the email address is not confirmed yet. Enter the six-digit code we emailed you on the sign-up screen, or if you received a link, click it. Then come back here and continue. If you land back on this page, the email is not confirmed yet.
remote.confirmEmailBody.chinese: 注册成功，但邮箱地址尚未确认。请在注册页面输入我们通过电子邮件发送给你的六位数代码；如果收到的是链接，请点击该链接。然后返回此处继续操作。如果再次回到此页面，说明邮箱仍未确认。
remote.confirmEmailBody.machine: 您的注册有效, 但电子邮件地址尚未确认 。 输入我们在注册屏幕上发来的六位数代码, 或者如果你收到链接, 请点击它 。 那就回来继续 如果您返回此页面, 电子邮件尚未确认 。

remote.confirmEmailSpam.english: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam or junk folder for an email from Nexus Remote. A code works for fifteen minutes, and a link for five days.
remote.confirmEmailSpam.chinese: 几分钟后仍未收到邮件？请检查垃圾邮件文件夹中是否有来自 Nexus Remote 的邮件。验证码有效期为 15 分钟，确认链接有效期为 5 天。
remote.confirmEmailSpam.machine: 几分钟后就没消息了? 请检查url=值 (帮助) Nexus 远程邮件的垃圾邮件或垃圾文件夹。 密码工作15分钟 链接5天

remote.trialActiveElsewhere.english: This email address already has a Remote trial running under a different sign-in, such as Google instead of a password. Sign out, then sign in the way you did the first time.
remote.trialActiveElsewhere.chinese: 此邮箱已通过另一种登录方式启用 Remote 试用，例如使用 Google 登录而非密码。请先退出，然后使用首次登录时采用的方式重新登录。
remote.trialActiveElsewhere.machine: 这个电子邮件地址已经有一个远程试验在不同的登录下运行,例如Google而不是密码. 签字,然后签字的方式 你第一次。

remote.tryLater.english: Too many tries. Wait up to ten minutes, then try again.
remote.tryLater.chinese: 尝试次数过多。请等待最多十分钟后重试。

remote.stationOffline.english: That station is not reachable. Check that Nexus is running at the shack and the computer is awake.
remote.stationOffline.chinese: 无法连接此电台。请确认电台室的 Nexus 正在运行且电脑未休眠。

remote.sessionEnded.english: Remote access to this station ended, so this browser was disconnected. Check your trial and your stations below.
remote.sessionEnded.chinese: 此电台的远程访问已结束，因此当前浏览器已断开连接。请查看下方的试用状态和电台列表。
remote.sessionEnded.machine: 这个站的远程访问结束,因此这个浏览器被断开. 看看你的审讯和下面的车站

remote.browserPerStation.english: Each station approves its browsers separately, so this browser needs approving for this station too.
remote.browserPerStation.chinese: 每台电台需分别批准浏览器，因此还需为此电台批准当前浏览器。

remote.sharedComputerHint.english: Signing out keeps this browser approved. On a shared computer, press “Remove this browser’s approval” for each station before you sign out.
remote.sharedComputerHint.chinese: 退出登录不会取消对此浏览器的批准。在共用电脑上，请先为每台电台点击“移除此浏览器的批准”，再退出登录。
remote.sharedComputerHint.machine: 签名后保留此浏览器 。 在一个共享的电脑上,在您签字之前,按“撤消这个浏览器的许可”。

remote.disconnect.chinese: 断开连接并返回电台列表

remote.thisBrowserApprovedUntil.english: This browser is approved until {{until}} UTC.
remote.thisBrowserApprovedUntil.chinese: 此浏览器已获批准，至 {{until}} UTC。

remote.thisBrowserApprovedUntilRemoved.english: This browser is approved until you remove it in Nexus at the shack.
remote.thisBrowserApprovedUntilRemoved.chinese: 此浏览器已获批准，直到你在电台室的 Nexus 中将其移除。

remote.thisBrowserRenewsUntil.english: This browser is approved until {{until}} UTC. Using the station from here keeps it approved, up to {{limit}} UTC.
remote.thisBrowserRenewsUntil.chinese: 此浏览器已获批准，至 {{until}} UTC。继续从此处使用电台可延长批准期限，最晚至 {{limit}} UTC。
remote.thisBrowserRenewsUntil.machine: 此浏览器被批准直到{{until}} UTC使用从这里到这里的车站 保持它的批准,直到{{limit}} UTC。 。 。

remote.thisBrowserApprovalEnding.english: This browser’s approval ends {{until}} UTC. To keep using it, approve it again in Nexus at the shack.
remote.thisBrowserApprovalEnding.chinese: 此浏览器的批准将于 {{until}} UTC 到期。如需继续使用，请在电台室的 Nexus 中重新批准。
remote.thisBrowserApprovalEnding.machine: 此浏览器的批准结束{{until}} UTC为了继续使用它,再次批准在Nexus的小屋。

remote.stationKey.changed.english: This station’s key has changed: the Remote service now lists a different key for it than the one this browser kept. Nothing connects until you accept the new key. Compare it with “This station’s key” in Nexus at the shack, and accept it only if they match.
remote.stationKey.changed.chinese: 此电台的密钥已更改：远程服务现在列出的密钥与此浏览器保存的密钥不同。接受新密钥前不会建立连接。请将此密钥与电台室 Nexus 中的“此电台的密钥”进行比较；只有两者一致时才接受。
remote.stationKey.changed.machine: 此站的密钥已经改变: 远程服务现在列出一个与浏览器保存的密钥不同的密钥 。 在您接受新密钥之前, 没有连接 。 与Nexus的"这台车钥匙"相比,

remote.revokeHint.english: Revoking access disconnects this station and removes the approval of every browser that used it. To use it again, pair it again at the shack and approve your browsers there again.
remote.revokeHint.chinese: 撤销访问权限会断开此电台，并移除所有曾连接此电台的浏览器授权。如需再次使用，请在电台室重新配对，并在那里重新批准浏览器。
remote.revokeHint.machine: 取消访问断开本站,并取消每个使用该站的浏览器的批准. 为了再次使用它,在小屋再次配对 并再次批准你的浏览器在那里。

remote.enterCodeHint.english: In Nexus at the shack, open Settings → Station → Remote access and start pairing. Enter the code shown there.
remote.enterCodeHint.chinese: 在电台室的 Nexus 中打开“设置 → 电台 → 远程访问”并开始配对，然后输入那里显示的代码。
remote.enterCodeHint.machine: 在小屋的Nexus, 开放设置 → 车站 → 远程接入并开始对接. 输入显示的代码 。

remote.approveInShackNamed.english: "{{station}}" is linked to your account and waiting for approval in Nexus at the shack. Match the account ID there and approve it. The code is good for about {{minutes}} more minutes.
remote.approveInShackNamed.chinese: “{{station}}”已关联到你的账号，正在等待电台室 Nexus 批准。请核对那里的账号 ID 并批准。此代码约在 {{minutes}} 分钟后过期。
remote.approveInShackNamed.machine: " (中文(简体) ).{{station}}" 与你的账户相连,在小屋Nexus等待批准。 匹配账户的ID 并批准它。 代码对关于{{minutes}}更多分钟。

remote.nativeIntro.english: Pair this station with your Remote account. Approving the pairing turns Remote on and approves the browser you paired from; approve any other browser here. While Remote is on, approved browsers receive your station, contact, radio and amplifier data.
remote.nativeIntro.chinese: 将此电台与你的 Remote 账号配对。批准配对会开启 Remote，并批准用于配对的浏览器；其他浏览器需在此单独批准。Remote 开启期间，已批准的浏览器可以接收电台、交信、无线电和功放数据。
remote.nativeIntro.machine: 用你的远程账户给这个站配对 批准配对打开远程并批准您配对的浏览器; 批准这里的任何其他浏览器 。 远程运行期间,经批准的浏览器接收您的站台,联系人,无线电和放大器数据.

remote.workDraftKept.english: Your current contact draft is unchanged. Start a new contact with {{call}} when ready.
remote.workDraftKept.chinese: 当前交信草稿保持不变。准备好后，可用 {{call}} 开始新交信。

remote.applicationObserver.english: Monitoring only. Operating controls are not available to this browser.
remote.applicationObserver.chinese: 仅供查看。此浏览器没有操作控制权限。

remote.viewUnavailable.english: This is not available from the browser right now. Open it in Nexus at the shack.
remote.viewUnavailable.chinese: 目前无法通过浏览器使用此功能。请在电台室的 Nexus 中打开。

remote.awardsObserver.english: Journey, confirmation diagnostics and uploads are not available remotely yet.
remote.awardsObserver.chinese: 远程暂不支持历程查看、确认诊断和上传。

remote.audio.gap.english: Audio gap - the link is losing packets
remote.audio.gap.chinese: 音频中断：网络正在丢包

remote.audio.stalled.english: Audio stalled - the link, not the band
remote.audio.stalled.chinese: 音频已停滞：问题出在网络连接，不是频段

remote.audio.unsupported.english: This browser cannot play station audio. Chrome, Edge, Firefox on a computer, or Safari 26 can.
remote.audio.unsupported.chinese: 此浏览器无法播放电台音频。电脑端 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Safari 26 可用。

remote.audio.sourceChanged.english: The station changed its audio device. Press Listen again.
remote.audio.sourceChanged.chinese: 电台已更改音频设备。请再次点击“收听”。

remote.audio.inUse.english: Another browser is listening to this station.
remote.audio.inUse.chinese: 另一个浏览器正在收听此电台。

remote.audio.notController.english: Audio stopped because station control was lost.
remote.audio.notController.chinese: 电台控制权限已丢失，音频已停止。

remote.stationFiles.save.title.english: Copy the file from the station into this computer’s Downloads folder
remote.stationFiles.save.title.chinese: 将电台上的文件复制到此电脑的“下载”文件夹

remote.stationFiles.save.failed.english: Could not save the station’s file to this computer
remote.stationFiles.save.failed.chinese: 无法将电台上的文件保存到此电脑

remote.stationFiles.list.title.sstv.chinese: 电台上的 SSTV 图像

remote.stationFiles.list.failed.english: Could not list the station’s files
remote.stationFiles.list.failed.chinese: 无法列出电台上的文件

remote.stop.sent.title.english: The station has accepted the Stop. It is not off the air until the station reports the transmitter free.
remote.stop.sent.title.chinese: 电台已接受 Stop 命令。只有电台报告发射机已空闲后，才能确认发射已停止。
remote.stop.sent.title.machine: 该站已接受停站. 在电台报告发射机免费前,它不会停播。

remote.stop.stopped.title.english: The station reports the transmitter free.
remote.stop.stopped.title.chinese: 电台报告发射机已空闲。

remote.audio.unavailable.english: The station has no audio to send right now.
remote.audio.unavailable.chinese: 电台目前没有可发送的音频。

remote.stream.picture.english: Nexus at the shack. Click it, then use your mouse and keyboard to operate it. Tab leaves the picture.
remote.stream.picture.chinese: 电台室 Nexus 的画面。点击画面后可用鼠标和键盘操作。按 Tab 键可移出画面。
remote.stream.picture.machine: 尼克萨斯在小屋。 单击它,然后使用鼠标和键盘操作它。 Tab 离开图片。

remote.stream.fullscreen.title.english: Fill the screen with the stream, Stop TX included. Esc still stops transmitting.
remote.stream.fullscreen.title.chinese: 全屏显示串流画面（包含“停止发射”按钮）。按 Esc 仍可停止发射。

remote.stream.typing.english: Type here for the field selected at the shack
remote.stream.typing.chinese: 在此输入内容，将发送到电台端当前选中的输入框

remote.stream.turn.english: Turn the phone on its side for a bigger picture.
remote.stream.turn.chinese: 将手机横屏以获得更大的画面。

remote.stream.ptt.title.english: Hold to talk: the rig keys when your microphone's audio arrives, and unkeys when you let go or the picture stops.
remote.stream.ptt.title.chinese: 按住即可通话：你的麦克风音频到达后电台开始发射；松开按键或画面停止更新时，电台停止发射。
remote.stream.ptt.title.machine: 坚持说话:麦克风的音频到来时的钻机键,放行或画面停止时的未键.

remote.stream.permission.english: Station control is off for this browser. Allow it in Nexus at the shack (Settings → Station → Remote access → Advanced), then try again.
remote.stream.permission.chinese: 此浏览器尚未获准控制电台。请在电台室 Nexus 中开启控制权限（设置 → 电台 → 远程访问 → 高级），然后重试。
remote.stream.permission.machine: 这个浏览器关闭了站台控制 允许在Nexus在小屋(Settings → station → 远程接入 → 高级),然后再试一次.

remote.stream.occupied.english: Another browser is using this station. You can start once it lets go.
remote.stream.occupied.chinese: 另一个浏览器正在使用此电台。对方释放后即可开始。

remote.stream.ready.english: Ready. Start the stream to see and operate Nexus at the shack.
remote.stream.ready.chinese: 已就绪。开始串流即可查看并操作电台室的 Nexus。

remote.stream.display.english: The stream is the Nexus window as Windows draws it at the shack, so Nexus there must stay open, and not minimized.
remote.stream.display.chinese: 此串流显示的是 Windows 在电台室绘制的 Nexus 窗口，因此电台室的 Nexus 必须保持打开，不能最小化。
remote.stream.display.machine: 溪流是Windows在小屋绘制时的Nexus窗口,所以Nexus那里必须保持开放,而不是最小化.

remote.stream.refused.english: The station couldn't start the stream just now. Start the stream again.
remote.stream.refused.chinese: 电台暂时无法启动串流。请重试。

remote.stream.live.chinese: 正在串流显示电台室的 Nexus

remote.stream.stalled.english: The picture has stopped updating. The station will not transmit for this browser until it moves again.
remote.stream.stalled.chinese: 画面已停止更新。在画面恢复更新前，电台不会允许此浏览器发射。
remote.stream.stalled.machine: 图片已停止更新。 该站不会为这个浏览器传输,直到它再次移动.

remote.stream.noPresence.english: The station is holding off transmitting for this browser until its picture here catches up.
remote.stream.noPresence.chinese: 当前画面尚未追上，电台暂不允许此浏览器发射。

remote.stream.mic.title.english: Your microphone, for talking on the rig. It stays off until you turn it on, and your browser asks first. Then hold PTT and talk: the rig keys when your audio arrives.
remote.stream.mic.title.chinese: 用于通过电台通话的麦克风。默认关闭；开启时浏览器会先请求麦克风权限。然后按住 PTT 通话：麦克风音频到达后，电台才会开始发射。
remote.stream.mic.title.machine: 你的麦克风,在钻机上说话。 它一直关闭直到你打开它, 你的浏览器先问。 坚持住PTT和说话: 钻机钥匙 当你的音频到达。

remote.stream.mic.level.title.english: How loud your voice goes to the rig, over your microphone's own level. Talk as you would on the air and raise it until your loudest words reach the end of the bar. Peaks are held 3 dB under full scale, so it never clips. This browser remembers it.
remote.stream.mic.level.title.chinese: 调节发送到电台的语音音量，此设置叠加在麦克风本身的音量之上。像正常通联时那样说话并调高音量，直到最响的语句到达音量条末端。峰值会保持在满量程以下 3 dB，以避免削波。此浏览器会记住该设置。
remote.stream.mic.level.title.machine: 你的声音对钻机的声响, 超过你的麦克风自己的水平。 继续说吧,直到你最大声的词 到达酒吧的尽头 峰顶在全尺寸下为3dB,因此从不剪辑. 这个浏览器记得它。

remote.stream.mic.usb.english: The rig must take its SSB audio from USB (its menu for the transmit audio source). Most radios come set to the front microphone, and then an over sends the shack's microphone instead of you.
remote.stream.mic.usb.chinese: 电台必须从 USB 输入获取 SSB 发射音频（在电台菜单中设置发射音频源）。多数电台默认使用前置麦克风；若不更改，你发射出去的会是电台室的麦克风音频，而不是你的声音。
remote.stream.mic.usb.machine: 钻机必须从 USB (传输音频源的菜单) 中获取其 SSB 音频 。 大部分收音机都设置在前方的麦克风上,然后一个上空发送小屋的麦克风而不是你.

remote.stream.mic.denied.site.english: The microphone is blocked for this site. Allow it in the browser's settings for this site (the icon at the left of the address bar), then turn the microphone on again.
remote.stream.mic.denied.site.chinese: 此网站被禁止使用麦克风。请在浏览器的此网站设置中允许麦克风（点击地址栏左侧的图标），然后重新开启麦克风。
remote.stream.mic.denied.site.machine: 这个网站的麦克风被封锁了 允许它在这个网站的浏览器设置中(地址栏左边的图标),然后再次打开麦克风.

remote.stream.mic.denied.system.english: Your computer's privacy settings are blocking the microphone for the browser. On Windows, open Settings ▸ Privacy & security ▸ Microphone and turn on microphone access, including for desktop apps. On a Mac, open System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security ▸ Microphone, turn the browser on, and reopen it. Then turn the microphone on again.
remote.stream.mic.denied.system.chinese: 电脑的隐私设置禁止浏览器使用麦克风。Windows：打开“设置 → 隐私和安全性 → 麦克风”，开启麦克风访问权限，包括桌面应用。Mac：打开“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 麦克风”，允许浏览器使用麦克风并重新打开浏览器。然后再次开启麦克风。
remote.stream.mic.denied.system.machine: 您的计算机的隐私设置正在屏蔽浏览器的麦克风. 在Windows上,打开设置QQ隐私和安全QQ微机并开启麦克风访问,包括桌面应用. 在Mac上,打开系统设置QQ隐私和安全QQ微机,打开浏览器,重新打开. 然后再次打开麦克风。

remote.stream.mic.denied.dismissed.english: The browser's question about the microphone was closed without an answer. Turn the microphone on again and choose Allow.
remote.stream.mic.denied.dismissed.chinese: 你关闭了浏览器的麦克风权限询问，尚未作出选择。请再次开启麦克风并选择“允许”。
remote.stream.mic.denied.dismissed.machine: 浏览器对麦克风的质疑被关闭,没有答案. 打开麦克风再选择允许

remote.stream.mic.denied.noDevice.english: No microphone was found on this computer. Plug one in, then turn the microphone on again.
remote.stream.mic.denied.noDevice.chinese: 此电脑上未找到麦克风。请连接麦克风后重新开启。

remote.stream.mic.denied.busy.english: The microphone was found but could not start. Another program may be using it: close that program, then turn the microphone on again.
remote.stream.mic.denied.busy.chinese: 已找到麦克风，但无法启动。可能有其他程序正在使用它；请关闭该程序，然后重新开启麦克风。
remote.stream.mic.denied.busy.machine: 麦克风被发现但无法启动 。 另一个程序可能是使用它:关闭程序,然后再次打开麦克风.

remote.stream.mic.denied.other.english: The browser could not get the microphone ({{name}}). Check the browser's settings for this site and the computer's microphone settings, then turn the microphone on again.
remote.stream.mic.denied.other.chinese: 浏览器无法访问麦克风（{{name}}）。请检查此网站的浏览器权限和电脑的麦克风设置，然后重新开启麦克风。
remote.stream.mic.denied.other.machine: 浏览器无法获取麦克风( Q){{name}}) (中文(简体) ). 检查浏览器在这个网站的设置和计算机的麦克风设置,然后再次打开麦克风.

remote.stream.mic.unavailable.english: This browser cannot send the microphone on this stream.
remote.stream.mic.unavailable.chinese: 此浏览器无法通过当前串流发送麦克风音频。

remote.stream.mic.processing.english: The browser is still processing the microphone (echo cancellation, noise suppression or automatic gain), which can make your voice sound worse on the air.
remote.stream.mic.processing.chinese: 浏览器仍在处理麦克风音频（回声消除、噪声抑制或自动增益），这可能会降低发射语音的音质。
remote.stream.mic.processing.machine: 浏览器仍在处理麦克风(echo取消,噪声压制或自动增益),这可能会使你的声音在播出时更糟糕.

remote.stream.mic.needed.english: PTT is held but your microphone is off, so nothing is transmitted. Turn the microphone on to talk.
remote.stream.mic.needed.chinese: PTT 已按下，但麦克风关闭，因此没有发射。请开启麦克风后通话。

remote.stream.mic.noPower.english: The rig shows no power out while your voice is arriving. Set its SSB audio source to USB (its menu for the transmit audio source).
remote.stream.mic.noPower.chinese: 你的语音到达时，电台没有显示射频输出功率。请将电台的 SSB 发射音频源设为 USB（在电台菜单中设置发射音频源）。
remote.stream.mic.noPower.machine: 钻井机显示,没有电 当你的声音到达。 将其 SSB 音频源设置为 USB( 传输音频源的菜单) 。

remote.stream.mic.uplink.english: Your connection stalled, so the transmission stopped.
remote.stream.mic.uplink.chinese: 网络连接停滞，发射已停止。

remote.stream.mic.ended.audioGap.english: Your audio stopped arriving, so the transmission stopped.
remote.stream.mic.ended.audioGap.chinese: 麦克风音频中断，发射已停止。

remote.stream.mic.ended.presence.english: Control was lost, so the transmission stopped.
remote.stream.mic.ended.presence.chinese: 控制连接已丢失，发射已停止。

remote.stream.mic.ended.ceiling.english: The transmission ended at its 10-minute limit. Press PTT again to carry on.
remote.stream.mic.ended.ceiling.chinese: 发射达到 10 分钟上限，已结束。按下 PTT 可继续。

remote.stream.mic.ended.watchdog.english: The TX watchdog stopped the transmission.
remote.stream.mic.ended.watchdog.chinese: TX 看门狗已停止发射。

remote.stream.mic.ended.routeChanged.english: The station's audio changed, so the transmission stopped. Press PTT again.
remote.stream.mic.ended.routeChanged.chinese: 电台音频设备已更改，发射已停止。请再次按下 PTT。

remote.stream.id.due.english: Time to give your call sign.

remote.stream.id.end.english: Remember to give your call sign at the end of the contact.
remote.stream.id.end.chinese: 请记得在交信结束时报出呼号。

remote.stream.idle.prompt.english: Still there? The stream ends in a minute unless you click.
remote.stream.idle.prompt.chinese: 还在吗？若不点击，串流将在一分钟后结束。

remote.stream.idle.ended.english: Nobody answered “Still there?”, so the stream ended.
remote.stream.idle.ended.chinese: 未收到对“还在吗？”的回应，串流已结束。

remote.stream.ended.notController.english: The stream ended because station control was lost.
remote.stream.ended.notController.chinese: 电台控制权限已丢失，串流已结束。

remote.stream.ended.unavailable.english: This station can't stream yet. Update Nexus at the shack and turn streaming on there.
remote.stream.ended.unavailable.chinese: 此电台尚不支持串流。请更新电台室的 Nexus 并开启串流。

remote.stream.ended.accessExpired.english: Your Remote access has ended, so the stream can't start.
remote.stream.ended.accessExpired.chinese: 远程访问权限已到期，无法开始串流。

remote.stream.ended.remoteOff.english: Remote access was switched off for this account, so the stream ended.
remote.stream.ended.remoteOff.chinese: 此账号的远程访问已关闭，串流已结束。

remote.stream.ended.tryLater.english: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then start the stream again.
remote.stream.ended.tryLater.chinese: 尝试次数过多。请等待一分钟后重新开始串流。

remote.stream.ended.lanOnly.english: Your Remote access over the internet has ended, so the stream works only on the shack's own network. Connect this device to the same network as the station, then start the stream again.
remote.stream.ended.lanOnly.chinese: 你的互联网远程访问已结束，因此串流只能在电台室本地网络中使用。请将此设备连接到与电台相同的网络，然后重新开始串流。
remote.stream.ended.lanOnly.machine: 你通过互联网的远程访问已经结束,所以溪流只在小屋自己的网络上工作. 将这个设备连接到与车站相同的网络,然后再次启动溪流.

remote.stream.ended.updateStation.english: Streaming on the shack's own network needs a newer Nexus at the shack. Update Nexus there, then start the stream again.
remote.stream.ended.updateStation.chinese: 要在电台室本地网络中串流，需要更新电台室的 Nexus。请先在那里更新 Nexus，然后重新开始串流。
remote.stream.ended.updateStation.machine: 在小屋的网络上流水 需要一个新的Nexus在小屋。 在那里更新 Nexus, 然后重新开始溪流 。

remote.stream.ended.insecure.english: The station's reply was not encrypted end to end, so the stream was refused.
remote.stream.ended.insecure.chinese: 电台回复未进行端到端加密，因此串流请求已拒绝。

remote.stream.ended.unsupported.english: This browser can't show the stream. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
remote.stream.ended.unsupported.chinese: 此浏览器无法显示串流。请使用最新版 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Safari。

remote.stream.ended.hidden.english: The stream stops while this tab is in the background. Start it again when you're back.
remote.stream.ended.hidden.chinese: 此标签页转入后台后串流停止。返回后请重新开始。

remote.stream.ended.failed.english: The connection to the station was lost. Start the stream again.
remote.stream.ended.failed.chinese: 与电台的连接已断开。请重新开始串流。

remote.stream.ended.disabled.english: Streaming is off at the shack. In Nexus there, turn on “Stream this station from my browser” (Settings → Station → Remote access), then start the stream again.
remote.stream.ended.disabled.chinese: 电台室的串流功能已关闭。请在电台室 Nexus 中开启“从浏览器串流此电台”（设置 → 电台 → 远程访问），然后重新开始串流。
remote.stream.ended.disabled.machine: 电流在小屋里 在Nexus,从我的浏览器(Settings → station → 远程访问)上打开“这个站台”然后再次启动溪流。

remote.stream.ended.inUse.english: Another browser is streaming this station. You can stream once it ends.
remote.stream.ended.inUse.chinese: 另一个浏览器正在串流此电台。对方结束后即可使用。

remote.stream.ended.invalidOffer.english: The station could not use this browser's stream request. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
remote.stream.ended.invalidOffer.chinese: 电台无法处理此浏览器的串流请求。请使用最新版 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Safari。
remote.stream.ended.invalidOffer.machine: 该站无法使用此浏览器的流请求 。 使用当前Chrome,边缘,Firefox或Safari.

remote.stream.ended.notPinned.english: Nexus at the shack is asking you to approve this browser. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then start the stream again.
remote.stream.ended.notPinned.chinese: 电台室的 Nexus 正在请求批准此浏览器。如果那里显示下方的浏览器密钥，请在电台端批准，然后重新开始串流。
remote.stream.ended.notPinned.machine: 在小屋的Nexus要你批准这个浏览器 如果显示浏览器的密钥, 请在下面批准, 然后再次启动流 。

remote.stream.ended.keyChanged.english: This browser’s key has changed, so Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it again. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then start the stream again.
remote.stream.ended.keyChanged.chinese: 此浏览器的密钥已更改，电台室 Nexus 要求重新批准。如果电台端显示下方的浏览器密钥，请在那里批准，然后重新开始串流。
remote.stream.ended.keyChanged.machine: 这个浏览器的密钥已经改变,所以在小屋的Nexus要求你再次批准. 如果显示浏览器的密钥, 请在下面批准, 然后再次启动流 。

remote.stream.ended.stationKey.english: This reply was not signed with your station's key, so it may not have come from your station. Nothing was connected.
remote.stream.ended.stationKey.chinese: 电台的密钥未能验证此回复，因此回复可能并非来自你的电台。连接未建立。
remote.stream.ended.stationKey.machine: 这个答复没有用你站的钥匙签名,所以可能不是来自你站的. 没有任何关联。

remote.stream.ended.stationUnsigned.english: Nexus at the shack did not sign its reply, so this browser can't tell it came from your station. Update Nexus at the shack, then start the stream again.
remote.stream.ended.stationUnsigned.chinese: 电台室的 Nexus 未对回复签名，因此此浏览器无法确认回复来自你的电台。请更新电台室的 Nexus，然后重新开始串流。
remote.stream.ended.stationUnsigned.machine: 在小屋的Nexus没有在它的答复上签名,所以这个浏览器无法辨别它来自你的站台. 在小屋更新Nexus,然后重新开始溪流.

remote.stream.ended.stationKeyChanged.english: This station’s key has changed, so nothing was connected. Return to your stations to compare the new key with “This station’s key” in Nexus at the shack.
remote.stream.ended.stationKeyChanged.chinese: 此电台的密钥已更改，因此未建立连接。请返回电台列表，将新密钥与电台室 Nexus 中的“此电台的密钥”进行比较。
remote.stream.ended.stationKeyChanged.machine: 这个站台的钥匙已经变了,所以没有任何连接. 回到你们的站台来比较新密钥与Nexus的"这个站的密钥",

remote.stream.offline.english: The station isn't online. Check that Nexus is running at the shack with Remote turned on, and that the computer is awake.
remote.stream.offline.chinese: 电台当前离线。请确认电台室的 Nexus 正在运行、Remote 已开启，并且电脑未休眠。
remote.stream.offline.machine: 该站不在线. 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) Nexus在小屋里运行 遥控器打开 电脑醒了

remote.listen.ready.english: Ready. Press Listen to hear the station's receive audio.
remote.listen.ready.chinese: 已就绪。点击“收听”以收听电台的接收音频。

remote.listen.refused.english: The station couldn't start just now. Press Listen again.
remote.listen.refused.chinese: 电台暂时无法开始收听。请再次点击“收听”。

remote.listen.notPinned.english: Nexus at the shack is asking you to approve this browser. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then press Listen again.
remote.listen.notPinned.chinese: 电台室的 Nexus 正在请求批准此浏览器。如果那里显示下方的浏览器密钥，请在电台端批准，然后再次点击“收听”。
remote.listen.notPinned.machine: 在小屋的Nexus要你批准这个浏览器 如果显示浏览器的密钥, 请再按一次。

remote.listen.keyChanged.english: This browser’s key has changed, so Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it again. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then press Listen again.
remote.listen.keyChanged.chinese: 此浏览器的密钥已更改，电台室 Nexus 要求重新批准。如果电台端显示下方的浏览器密钥，请在那里批准，然后再次点击“收听”。
remote.listen.keyChanged.machine: 这个浏览器的密钥已经改变,所以在小屋的Nexus要求你再次批准. 如果显示浏览器的密钥, 请再按一次。

remote.listen.unavailable.english: This station isn't sending its receive audio. Check that Nexus at the shack is up to date and has the radio's audio input set.
remote.listen.unavailable.chinese: 此电台当前未发送接收音频。请确认电台室的 Nexus 已更新，并已设置电台的音频输入。
remote.listen.unavailable.machine: 这个电台不会发送接收到的音频 请检查access-date=中的日期值 (帮助) Nexus at the hook 最新,并有收音机的音频输入设置.

remote.card.ready.english: Ready. Stream to see and operate Nexus at the shack, or Listen for its audio only.
remote.card.ready.chinese: 已就绪。点击“串流”查看并操作电台室的 Nexus，或点击“收听”仅收听音频。

remote.card.notApproved.english: This browser isn't approved for this station yet. Press Stream, and Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it.
remote.card.notApproved.chinese: 此浏览器尚未获准访问此电台。点击“串流”后，电台室的 Nexus 会提示批准。
remote.card.notApproved.machine: 这个浏览器还没有为本站批准. Press Stream, Nexus在小屋里要你批准

remote.card.waiting.english: Waiting for approval at the shack: Nexus there asks whether to let “{{browser}}” stream. Approve it if it shows this key: {{key}}.
remote.card.waiting.chinese: 正在等待电台室批准：电台室 Nexus 会询问是否允许“{{browser}}”进行串流。只有显示此密钥时才批准：{{key}}。
remote.card.waiting.machine: 在小屋等待批准:Nexus问是否允许“......{{browser}}“溪流。 如果显示此密钥, 请批准 :{{key}}。 。 。

remote.card.waitingNoKey.english: Waiting for approval at the shack: Nexus there asks whether to let “{{browser}}” stream. Approve it there.
remote.card.waitingNoKey.chinese: 正在等待电台室批准：电台室的 Nexus 会询问是否允许“{{browser}}”进行串流。请在电台室批准。
remote.card.waitingNoKey.machine: 在小屋等待批准:Nexus问是否允许“......{{browser}}“溪流。 在那里批准它。

remote.configurationLocal.english: Manage accounts, backups and remote access in Nexus at the station, in person or streamed to this browser.
remote.configurationLocal.chinese: 请在电台上的 Nexus 中管理账号、备份和远程访问；你可以在电台旁操作，也可以将 Nexus 窗口串流到此浏览器后操作。
remote.configurationLocal.machine: 在站内管理Nexus的账户,备份和远程访问,亲自或流到这个浏览器.

remote.nativeAwaitingConfirmation.english: Confirm this station in your browser first — the Remote page is asking whether to attach it. Then approve here again.
remote.nativeAwaitingConfirmation.chinese: 请先在浏览器中的 Remote 页面确认要关联此电台，然后回到这里再次批准。
remote.nativeAwaitingConfirmation.machine: 首先在您的浏览器中确认此站——远程页面正在询问是否附加它 。 那就再在这里批准一次

remote.nativeTrialEnded.english: Your Remote trial has ended, so this station could not be added to the account. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
remote.nativeTrialEnded.chinese: Remote 试用期已结束，因此无法将此电台添加到账号。你的电台、交信日志和设置均未更改。
remote.nativeTrialEnded.machine: 您的远程审判已经结束, 所以这个站无法添加到账户中 。 你的收音机,你的日志和设置没有受到影响.

remote.nativeTrialDisabled.english: Remote access for this account has been switched off, so this station could not be added to it. This is not the trial running out. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
remote.nativeTrialDisabled.chinese: 此账号的 Remote 访问权限已关闭，因此无法将此电台添加到账号。这不是试用期到期；你的电台、交信日志和设置均未更改。
remote.nativeTrialDisabled.machine: 这个账户的远程访问已被关闭,因此本站无法添加到其中. 这不是审判结束。 你的收音机,你的日志和设置没有受到影响.

remote.nativeCallsignInvalid.english: A Remote trial is one per callsign, so set your station callsign in Settings → Station first, then pair this station again. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
remote.nativeCallsignInvalid.chinese: 每个呼号只能使用一次 Remote 试用。请先在“设置 → 电台”中填写本台呼号，再重新配对。你的电台、交信日志和设置均未更改。
remote.nativeCallsignInvalid.machine: 远程试验是每个呼叫标志一个, 所以设置您的站呼叫标志 在设置 = 站,然后再次对这个站。 你的收音机,你的日志和设置没有受到影响.

remote.nativeTrialUsedByCallsign.english: This callsign has already had a Remote trial under another account, so this station could not be added. If this is your callsign, write to support from the email address on your licence. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
remote.nativeTrialUsedByCallsign.chinese: 此呼号已在其他账号下使用过 Remote 试用，因此无法添加此电台。如果这是你的呼号，请使用业余电台执照登记的邮箱联系支持。你的电台、交信日志和设置均未更改。
remote.nativeTrialUsedByCallsign.machine: 这个呼号已经在另一个账户下进行了远程试验,因此这个站站无法添加. 如果这是您的呼号, 请从您的许可证上的电子邮件地址中写入支持 。 你的收音机,你的日志和设置没有受到影响.

remote.restartHint.english: Remote stays on when Nexus restarts: if it was on when Nexus closed, it turns itself back on and reconnects. Approved browsers keep what you allowed, FT8/FT4 transmit included. Transmit is always off after a restart until the browser turns it on again. Turn off Remote only disconnects: turning it back on restores what each approved browser had.
remote.restartHint.chinese: Nexus 重启后会恢复 Remote：如果关闭 Nexus 时 Remote 处于开启状态，重启后会自动重新开启并连接。已批准浏览器原有的权限会保留，包括 FT8/FT4 发射权限。每次重启后，发射都会默认关闭，必须由浏览器再次开启。关闭 Remote 只会断开连接；重新开启后，各浏览器会恢复原有权限。
remote.restartHint.machine: Nexus重启时保持远程状态:如果Nexus关闭时是开启的,则会恢复并重新连接. 授权浏览器保留你允许的, FT8/FT4 发送包含。 在重启后, 传送总是关闭, 直到浏览器再次打开它 。 关闭远程只断开: 恢复每个批准浏览器的功能 。

remote.account.peopleHint.english: Invite someone by the address they sign in with. Their devices are added when they sign in. Someone invited to operate transmits with your station, under your callsign: you stay responsible as its licensee.
remote.account.peopleHint.chinese: 请输入对方用于登录的邮箱地址来发送邀请。对方登录后，其设备会自动添加。获邀操作电台的人可以使用你的电台并以你的呼号发射；作为执照持有人，你仍须承担相应责任。
remote.account.peopleHint.machine: 请人通过他们签的地址。 他们的装置在注册时会加入. 有人被邀请与你的电台一起操作传输, 在你的呼号下: 你继续负责 作为它的许可证。

remote.account.operateIsYours.english: Someone invited to operate can do all you can from another computer: transmit under your callsign, edit, export or delete your log, upload with your saved logins (LoTW signed with your certificate), spot under your call and read your Winlink mail. Invite to operate only someone you would hand the shack to.
remote.account.operateIsYours.chinese: 获邀操作电台的人可以在另一台电脑上执行你能做的所有操作：使用你的呼号发射、编辑/导出/删除交信日志、使用你保存的账号上传（LoTW 会使用你的证书签名）、以你的呼号发布 DX 通报，以及读取你的 Winlink 邮件。只有你愿意把电台交由其操作的人，才应授予操作权限。
remote.account.operateIsYours.machine: 被邀请操作的人可以从另一台计算机上完成您所能完成的一切:在您的调用符号下发送,编辑,导出或删除您的日志,用您保存的日志上传(LoTW与您的证书一起签名),在您的呼叫中位置并读取您的Winlink邮件. 只邀请你把小屋交给某个人

remote.approval.body.english: A browser signed in to your Remote account asks to stream this station and operate it as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one the browser shows: {{key}}.
remote.approval.body.chinese: 有浏览器登录了你的 Remote 账号，请求串流并像在电台旁一样操作此电台（包括发射）。请核对密钥与浏览器显示的一致后再批准：{{key}}。
remote.approval.body.machine: 一个浏览器注册到您的远程账户, 要求流出此站, 并按您想要的操作它, 包括传输 。 只有在此密钥符合浏览器显示的密钥时, 才会批准 :{{key}}。 。 。

remote.approval.bodyAgain.english: This browser was approved before, but it can’t stream until you approve it again here. When it streams, it can operate this station as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one the browser shows: {{key}}.
remote.approval.bodyAgain.chinese: 此浏览器之前获准连接，但需要在这里重新批准后才能串流。串流期间，它可以像在电台旁一样操作电台（包括发射）。请核对密钥与浏览器显示的一致后再批准：{{key}}。
remote.approval.bodyAgain.machine: 这个浏览器之前就已经得到批准, 当它流出时, 它可以运行这个站 就像你在这里,传输包含。 只有在此密钥符合浏览器显示的密钥时, 才会批准 :{{key}}。 。 。

remote.lan.guest.english: A guest network, or one that keeps its devices apart, stops other computers reaching this one, and Nexus can’t tell that from here.
remote.lan.guest.chinese: 访客网络或启用了设备隔离的网络会阻止其他电脑连接此电脑。Nexus 无法从当前连接判断是否属于这种情况。

remote.lan.firewall.public.english: Windows calls this network Public, so its firewall keeps other computers out. If this is your own network, make it Private in Windows Settings ▸ Network & internet.
remote.lan.firewall.public.chinese: Windows 将此网络标记为“公用”，因此防火墙会阻止其他电脑连接。如果这是你自己的可信网络，可在 Windows“设置 → 网络和 Internet”中将其设为“专用”。
remote.lan.firewall.public.machine: Windows称这个网络为Public,因此其防火墙将其他计算机关闭. 如果这是你自己的网络, 请让它在 Windows 设置 & Network & Internet 中私有 。

remote.lan.firewall.blocked.english: Windows Firewall blocks Nexus on this network, as it does after its question is cancelled. Allow Nexus on Private networks in Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall.
remote.lan.firewall.blocked.chinese: Windows 防火墙正在阻止 Nexus 通过此网络通信（关闭权限询问也会导致这种情况）。请在“Windows 安全中心 → 防火墙和网络保护 → 允许应用通过防火墙”中允许 Nexus 使用专用网络。
remote.lan.firewall.blocked.machine: Windows防火墙在这个网络上的块Nexus,如同它在问题被取消后所做的那样. 允许在Windows Security QQ防火墙和网络保护中的私人网络上使用 Nexus 允许通过防火墙使用应用程序.

remote.lan.firewall.blocksAll.english: Windows Firewall blocks every incoming connection on this network, so no other computer can reach this station.
remote.lan.firewall.blocksAll.chinese: Windows 防火墙已阻止此网络上的所有传入连接，因此其他电脑都无法连接到电台。
remote.lan.firewall.blocksAll.machine: Windows防火墙屏蔽了这个网络上每一个接通的连接,所以没有其他计算机可以到达这个站.

remote.lan.firewall.managed.english: This computer’s firewall is set by an administrator’s policy, which may keep other computers out. Ask whoever manages it to allow Nexus.
remote.lan.firewall.managed.chinese: 此电脑的防火墙由管理员策略控制，可能会阻止其他电脑连接。请联系管理员，将 Nexus 加入允许列表。
remote.lan.firewall.managed.machine: 这台计算机的防火墙是由管理员的政策设置的,这可能会让其他计算机无法使用. 问谁管理它 允许Nexus。

remote.lan.reach.otherNetwork.english: That address isn’t on this computer’s network. Join the station’s network, or check the address the station shows.
remote.lan.reach.otherNetwork.chinese: 该地址不属于此电脑当前连接的网络。请将电脑连接到电台所在的网络，或核对电台上显示的地址。
remote.lan.reach.otherNetwork.machine: 这个地址不在电脑网络上。 加入车站网络,或检查车站显示的地址。

remote.lan.reach.refused.english: The station’s computer answered, but nothing listens at that port: Remote over this network is off there, or on another port. Check the address the station shows.
remote.lan.reach.refused.chinese: 电台电脑有响应，但该端口没有服务在监听。可能是电台端未开启“通过此网络远程访问”，也可能使用了其他端口。请核对电台上显示的地址。
remote.lan.reach.refused.machine: 电台的电脑回答,但没有任何东西在那个端口听:这个网络的远程就在那里或另一个端口。 检查站台显示的地址.

remote.lan.reach.noAnswer.english: No answer from the station. Remote over this network may be off there, its firewall may be blocking Nexus (allow it on Private networks at the station), the network may keep its devices apart (guest Wi-Fi often does), or the station may be asleep. Nexus can’t tell which from here.
remote.lan.reach.noAnswer.chinese: 未收到电台的响应。可能是电台端未开启“通过此网络远程访问”，也可能是防火墙阻止了 Nexus（请在电台端允许 Nexus 通过专用网络通信），或网络启用了设备隔离（访客 Wi-Fi 常会如此），也可能是电台电脑处于睡眠状态。Nexus 无法从当前连接判断具体原因。
remote.lan.reach.noAnswer.machine: 车站没有回复 这个网络的远程可能在那里关闭,它的防火墙可能屏蔽着Nexus(在电台的私人网络上允许它),网络可能保持其设备的分离(客人经常是Wi-Fi),或者空间站可能睡着了. Nexus无法从这里分辨出什么。

lanWindow.intro.english: Operate a station from this computer, on the station’s network or over the internet. Sign in once with your Nexus Remote account, and your station is added here.
lanWindow.intro.chinese: 在此电脑上通过电台所在的网络或互联网操作电台。使用 Nexus Remote 账号登录一次后，你的电台就会显示在这里。
lanWindow.intro.machine: 使用该台的网络或互联网运行一个台站。 签一次你的Nexus远程账户 你的位置就在这里

lanWindow.forgetConfirm.english: Forget this station? This computer’s keys for it are deleted, and using it from here again needs a new sign-in (or a new code, for a station paired with one). If the station still lists this computer, remove it there too.
lanWindow.forgetConfirm.chinese: 确定移除此电台？此电脑保存的电台密钥将被删除。之后若要从此电脑再次连接，需要重新登录（若此前使用配对码，则需获取新配对码）。如果电台上仍列有此电脑，也请在那里将其移除。
lanWindow.forgetConfirm.machine: 忘了这个站? 这台电脑的密钥被删除, 从这里再次使用它需要一个新的登录(或一个新的编码, 如果车站还列出这台电脑,也去掉它.

lanWindow.pairHint.english: At the station, press Pair a computer under Remote over this network. It shows its address and a code that works once, within ten minutes.
lanWindow.pairHint.chinese: 请在电台端“通过此网络远程访问”下点击“配对电脑”。页面会显示电台地址和一个配对码；配对码只能使用一次，并在十分钟后失效。
lanWindow.pairHint.machine: 在车站,按一个电脑 远程覆盖这个网络。 它显示它的地址 和一个一次有效的代码, 在十分钟内。

lanWindow.reason.unreachable.english: Nothing answered. Check that the station is on, that Remote over this network is on there, and that this computer is on the same network.
lanWindow.reason.unreachable.chinese: 电台没有响应。请确认电台已开机，并已开启“通过此网络远程访问”；同时确认此电脑与电台连接在同一网络。
lanWindow.reason.unreachable.machine: 什么都没有回答。 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助)

lanWindow.reason.pairingClosed.english: The station is not pairing now. Press Pair a computer at the station, then type the new code within ten minutes.
lanWindow.reason.pairingClosed.chinese: 电台当前未开放配对。请在电台端点击“配对电脑”，然后在十分钟内输入新配对码。
lanWindow.reason.pairingClosed.machine: 车站目前不配对. 按平台电脑,然后在10分钟内输入新码.

remote.nativeStationKeyPinned.english: The Remote service holds a different key for this station than the one it signs its stream with, so browsers refuse its stream. Use Revoke station access, then pair this station again.
remote.nativeStationKeyPinned.chinese: Remote 服务保存的电台密钥与电台用于串流签名的密钥不一致，因此浏览器会拒绝串流。请点击“撤销电台访问权限”，然后重新配对此电台。

remote.vaultFailed.english: Unlock your operating system’s credential store and try again. Remote stays disabled if its credential cannot be stored securely.
remote.vaultFailed.chinese: 请解锁操作系统的凭据存储后重试。如果无法安全保存 Remote 凭据，Remote 将保持关闭。

remote.nativeRevoked.english: This station's access was revoked from a browser, so it has stopped connecting. Nothing here is broken — pair it again below when you want it back.
remote.nativeRevoked.chinese: 有人已在浏览器中撤销此电台的访问权限，因此电台已停止连接。这不是故障；需要恢复连接时，请在下方重新配对。

remote.nativeCallsignNotLicensed.english: The callsign in Settings → Station is not an active US licence in the FCC's licence list, so this station could not be added. Check it for a typo. A new licence takes about a day to appear there. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
remote.nativeCallsignNotLicensed.chinese: “设置 → 电台”中的呼号不在 FCC 有效的美国业余无线电执照名单中，因此无法添加此电台。请检查呼号是否输入有误。新执照通常约一天后才会出现在名单中。你的电台、交信日志和设置均未更改。

remote.nativeTrialUsedOnThisPc.english: This computer has already had a Remote trial under another account, so this station could not be added. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
remote.nativeTrialUsedOnThisPc.chinese: 此电脑已使用其他账号参加过 Remote 试用，因此无法添加此电台。你的电台、交信日志和设置均未更改。

remote.nativeUpdateRequired.english: Adding a station to Remote needs a newer Nexus. Update Nexus, then pair this station again. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
remote.nativeUpdateRequired.chinese: 要将电台添加到 Remote，需要使用较新版本的 Nexus。请更新 Nexus，然后重新配对此电台。你的电台、交信日志和设置均未更改。

remote.nativeTrialActiveElsewhere.english: This email address already has a Remote trial running under a different sign-in, such as Google instead of a password, so this station could not be added. In your browser, sign out, sign in the way you did the first time, then pair this station again. Your radio, your log and your settings are untouched.
remote.nativeTrialActiveElsewhere.chinese: 此邮箱已通过另一种登录方式启用 Remote 试用（例如使用 Google 登录，而不是密码登录），因此无法添加此电台。请在浏览器中退出账号，再按首次登录时使用的方式登录，然后重新配对电台。你的电台、交信日志和设置均未更改。

remote.autostartOffer.english: Remote can only come back after this computer restarts if Nexus starts too. Start Nexus when you sign in to this computer?
remote.autostartOffer.chinese: 这台电脑重启后，只有 Nexus 随系统启动，Remote 才能自动恢复。要在登录此电脑时启动 Nexus 吗？

remote.browserRenewsUntil.english: Approved until {{until}} UTC. Using the station from this browser keeps it approved, up to {{limit}} UTC.
remote.browserRenewsUntil.chinese: 此浏览器的批准有效期至 {{until}} UTC。继续通过此浏览器使用电台可延长批准期限，最晚至 {{limit}} UTC。

remote.browserKeyNotPinned.english: This browser can’t stream until you approve it again here. First check this key matches the one the browser shows.
remote.browserKeyNotPinned.chinese: 重新批准此浏览器后才能开始串流。请先确认此处显示的密钥与浏览器上的密钥一致。

remote.native.computerKeyNotPinned.english: This computer can’t connect until you approve it again here. First check this key matches the one Nexus shows on it.
remote.native.computerKeyNotPinned.chinese: 重新批准这台电脑后才能连接。请先确认此处显示的密钥与该电脑上 Nexus 显示的密钥一致。

remote.account.signInHint.english: Sign in with your Nexus Remote account in the browser that opens. There is no code: each of your other devices is then added when you sign in on it.
remote.account.signInHint.chinese: 请在自动打开的浏览器中登录 Nexus Remote 账号。此方式无需配对码；在其他设备上登录后，该设备也会自动添加。

remote.account.reproof.english: Sign in again to keep adding devices: the key your station's sign-in was checked with has been retired.
remote.account.reproof.chinese: 用于验证此电台登录信息的密钥已停用。请重新登录后再继续添加设备。

remote.account.unconfirmed.english: The Remote service says this device is yours, but Nexus could not confirm it. Approve it only if you added it yourself.
remote.account.unconfirmed.chinese: Remote 服务称此设备属于你，但 Nexus 无法验证这一点。只有确认是你本人添加的设备时才批准。

remote.approval.computerBody.english: Nexus on {{platform}}, signed in to your Remote account, asks to operate this station over the internet as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one Nexus shows on that computer: {{key}}.
remote.approval.computerBody.chinese: 已登录你 Remote 账号的 {{platform}} 版 Nexus 请求通过互联网操作此电台，权限与你在电台旁操作相同，包括发射。请核对密钥与那台电脑上的 Nexus 显示一致后再批准：{{key}}。

remote.approval.computerBodyAgain.english: Nexus on {{platform}} was approved before, but it can’t connect until you approve it again here. Connected, it can operate this station as you would here, transmit included. Approve it only if this key matches the one Nexus shows on that computer: {{key}}.
remote.approval.computerBodyAgain.chinese: 此 {{platform}} 版 Nexus 之前已获批准，但需要在这里重新批准后才能连接。连接后，它可以像你在电台旁一样操作电台，包括发射。请核对密钥与那台电脑上的 Nexus 显示一致后再批准：{{key}}。

remote.lan.intro.english: Lets Nexus on another computer on this network operate this station, with no internet needed. Pair each computer here once; it keeps access until you remove it.
remote.lan.intro.chinese: 允许同一网络中的另一台电脑通过 Nexus 操作此电台，无需连接互联网。每台电脑只需在此配对一次，之后会一直保留访问权限，直到你将其移除。

remote.lan.reason.noKey.english: Off: this station has no network key it can read. Press Reset network identity under Network identity below, then turn this on again. A reset removes every paired computer, so each one has to be paired again.
remote.lan.reason.noKey.chinese: 已关闭：电台无法读取网络密钥。请在下方“网络身份”中点击“重置网络身份”，然后重新开启此功能。重置会移除所有已配对电脑，之后需要逐台重新配对。

remote.lan.reason.addressGone.english: Not listening: {{address}} is not this computer’s address right now. Nexus listens there again when it is back, or choose another network.
remote.lan.reason.addressGone.chinese: 未在监听：{{address}} 目前不是此电脑的网络地址。该地址恢复后，Nexus 会自动在此监听；你也可以改选其他网络。

remote.lan.networkHint.english: Virtual adapters and VPNs are not offered: other computers on this network can’t reach this one through them.
remote.lan.networkHint.chinese: 虚拟网卡和 VPN 不在可选范围内，因为同一网络中的其他电脑无法通过它们连接到此电脑。

remote.lan.notNamed.english: Windows won’t let other computers find this station by name here, so type its address on the other computer.
remote.lan.notNamed.chinese: Windows 不支持其他电脑在此网络中按名称发现这台电台。请在另一台电脑上输入电台地址。

remote.lan.firewall.silent.english: Windows Firewall blocks new programs on this network without asking. Allow Nexus on Private networks in Windows Security ▸ Firewall & network protection ▸ Allow an app through firewall.
remote.lan.firewall.silent.chinese: Windows 防火墙会在不提示的情况下阻止新程序通过此网络通信。请在“Windows 安全中心 → 防火墙和网络保护 → 允许应用通过防火墙”中允许 Nexus 使用专用网络。

remote.lan.find.unavailable.english: Finding stations by name doesn’t work on this computer. Type the address the station shows.
remote.lan.find.unavailable.chinese: 此电脑无法按名称查找电台。请输入电台上显示的地址。

remote.lan.find.none.english: No station answered by name on this network. Type the address the station shows.
remote.lan.find.none.chinese: 在此网络上未能按名称发现电台。请输入电台上显示的地址。

remote.lan.typed.invalid.english: Type the address the station shows, like {{address}} or {{withPort}}.
remote.lan.typed.invalid.chinese: 请输入电台上显示的地址，例如 {{address}} 或 {{withPort}}。

lanWindow.lost.english: This window lost touch with Nexus. Close it, then open it again from Settings.
lanWindow.lost.chinese: 此窗口已与 Nexus 断开连接。请关闭窗口，再从“设置”中重新打开。

lanWindow.none.english: No station is on this computer yet. Sign in to add yours.
lanWindow.none.chinese: 此电脑尚未添加任何电台。请登录账号以添加你的电台。

lanWindow.reason.badAddress.english: That is not a station’s address. Type it as the station shows it, on this network.
lanWindow.reason.badAddress.chinese: 这不是有效的电台地址。请按电台显示的格式输入其在此网络中的地址。

lanWindow.reason.badCode.english: The code is sixteen characters, 0 to 9 and a to f. Check it against the station’s screen.
lanWindow.reason.badCode.chinese: 配对码为 16 位，只能包含数字 0–9 和字母 a–f。请对照电台屏幕检查。

lanWindow.reason.badName.english: Give this computer a name of 1 to 32 characters.
lanWindow.reason.badName.chinese: 电脑名称长度须为 1 至 32 个字符。

remote.lan.vaultFailed.english: Nexus could not read or keep this station’s network key and paired computers in your operating system’s credential store. Press Reset network identity under Network identity below. A reset removes every paired computer, so each one has to be paired again.
remote.lan.vaultFailed.chinese: Nexus 无法从操作系统的凭据存储中读取或保存此电台的网络密钥及已配对电脑。请在下方“网络身份”中点击“重置网络身份”。重置会移除所有已配对电脑，之后需要逐台重新配对。

remote.lan.resetHint.english: Resetting makes a new network key and removes every paired computer. Use it if this computer’s key may have been copied, then pair your computers again.
remote.lan.resetHint.chinese: 重置会生成新的网络密钥，并移除所有已配对电脑。如果怀疑此电脑的密钥已被复制，请执行重置，然后重新配对各台电脑。

remote.lan.firewallFirst.english: The first time this is turned on, Windows asks whether Nexus may use networks. Allow Private networks only.
remote.lan.firewallFirst.chinese: 首次开启时，Windows 会询问是否允许 Nexus 访问网络。请仅允许其通过专用网络通信。

remote.lan.firewall.ask.english: When Windows asks whether Nexus may use this network, allow Private networks only.
remote.lan.firewall.ask.chinese: Windows 询问是否允许 Nexus 使用此网络时，请仅允许其通过专用网络通信。

remote.lan.reason.noNetwork.english: Not listening: this computer is not on a private network.
remote.lan.reason.noNetwork.chinese: 未在监听：此电脑当前未连接到专用网络。

remote.lan.reason.portInUse.english: Not listening: another program is using its port.
remote.lan.reason.portInUse.chinese: 未在监听：该端口正被其他程序占用。

remote.lan.reason.unavailable.english: Not listening: it could not start on this computer.
remote.lan.reason.unavailable.chinese: 未在监听：此电脑无法启动网络服务。

remote.lan.codeWarning.english: Whoever types it in time can operate this station, transmit included, so keep it to yourself.
remote.lan.codeWarning.chinese: 任何人在有效期内输入此配对码，都能操作此电台，包括发射。请勿向他人泄露。

remote.lan.atShackOnly.english: Only at the station itself: this can’t be done through a stream.
remote.lan.atShackOnly.chinese: 只能在电台本机执行此操作，不能通过串流完成。

remote.lan.full.english: Eight computers are paired already. Remove one to pair another.
remote.lan.full.chinese: 已配对 8 台电脑。请先移除一台，再配对其他电脑。

remote.lan.unavailable.english: This station and the other computer both need Windows, for now.
remote.lan.unavailable.chinese: 目前电台和另一台电脑都必须运行 Windows。

remote.lan.reason.chooseAddress.english: Not listening: choose which of this computer’s networks to listen on.
remote.lan.reason.chooseAddress.chinese: 未在监听：请选择此电脑要通过哪个网络地址接受连接。

remote.lan.codeHint.english: Type this code in Nexus on the other computer. It works once, within ten minutes.
remote.lan.codeHint.chinese: 请在另一台电脑的 Nexus 中输入此配对码。配对码只能使用一次，并在十分钟后失效。

lanWindow.reason.wrongCode.english: The station refused the code. Check it against the station’s screen. After three wrong codes the station needs a new one.
lanWindow.reason.wrongCode.chinese: 电台拒绝了此配对码。请对照电台屏幕检查；连续输错三次后，电台会生成新的配对码。

lanWindow.reason.stationProofFailed.english: The code does not match the station’s. Check the code and the address. If both are right, something else on this network may be answering in the station’s place.
lanWindow.reason.stationProofFailed.chinese: 配对码与电台的不符。请核对配对码和地址；如果两者都正确，可能是此网络中的其他设备冒用了电台的地址并作出响应。

lanWindow.reason.keyChanged.english: This station’s key has changed. If Nexus was reinstalled at the station, or its network identity reset, pair this computer again.
lanWindow.reason.keyChanged.chinese: 此电台的密钥已更改。如果电台端重新安装过 Nexus 或重置了网络身份，请重新配对此电脑。

lanWindow.reason.notThisStation.english: A station answered by name, but it is not the one this computer paired with, so Nexus did not connect to it. Check that the station is on and that Remote over this network is on there, or type the address it shows.
lanWindow.reason.notThisStation.chinese: 有电台响应了名称查找，但不是此电脑配对的那一台，因此 Nexus 未连接。请确认目标电台已开机并开启“通过此网络远程访问”，或手动输入电台显示的地址。

lanWindow.reason.stationLeft.english: The station ended the connection. Remote over this network may have been turned off there, or this computer removed.
lanWindow.reason.stationLeft.chinese: 电台已断开连接。可能是电台端关闭了“通过此网络远程访问”，或移除了此电脑。

lanWindow.operateConfirm.english: Operate this station from here? Nexus closes and starts again driving it over this network, and this computer’s own station stays off until you press Leave.
lanWindow.operateConfirm.chinese: 要从此电脑操作这台电台吗？Nexus 将关闭并重新启动，改为通过此网络控制远端电台。按下“离开”之前，此电脑本机连接的电台会保持关闭。

lanWindow.reason.nameUnresolved.english: No computer on this network answers to that name. Check the name, or type the station’s address as it shows it.
lanWindow.reason.nameUnresolved.chinese: 此网络中没有电脑响应这个名称。请检查名称，或按电台显示的格式输入电台地址。

lanWindow.choiceHint.english: Operate runs Nexus here and works the radio from your own clicks and pop-outs. Streaming only shows a picture of the station’s screen.
lanWindow.choiceHint.chinese: “从此电脑操作”会在本机运行 Nexus，你可以在本机点击界面和弹出窗口来控制电台；“串流”则只显示电台屏幕画面。

lanWindow.internet.added.english: Internet road added (Beta): Operate from this computer uses it when this station is not on this network.
lanWindow.internet.added.chinese: 已添加互联网连接（Beta）：电台不在此网络中时，“从此电脑操作”会通过互联网连接。

lanWindow.internet.hint.english: Sign in to Nexus Remote in your web browser, so Operate from this computer can reach this station over the internet when it is not on this network.
lanWindow.internet.hint.chinese: 请在浏览器中登录 Nexus Remote。电台不在此网络中时，“从此电脑操作”即可通过互联网连接到电台。

lanWindow.internet.waiting.english: Internet road added. Approve this computer at the station, under Remote access, before you use it, and only if the station shows this computer’s key: {{key}}.
lanWindow.internet.waiting.chinese: 互联网连接已添加。使用前，请在电台端的“远程访问”中批准此电脑；只有电台显示的电脑密钥与此密钥一致时才批准：{{key}}。

lanWindow.internet.reason.internetNotInc.english: The internet road is part of Nexus Remote’s paid service, and your account does not include it now. Operating on this network stays free.
lanWindow.internet.reason.internetNotInc.chinese: 通过互联网连接属于 Nexus Remote 付费服务，目前你的账号未包含此服务。在电台所在的本地网络中操作仍然免费。

lanWindow.internet.forgetUnreached.english: Forgotten on this computer, but Nexus Remote could not be told. At the station, remove this computer under Remote access ▸ Your computers.
lanWindow.internet.forgetUnreached.chinese: 已从此电脑移除，但无法通知 Nexus Remote。请在电台端打开“远程访问 → 你的电脑”，并移除此电脑。

lanWindow.internet.reason.stationUnavail.english: Your Remote account has no station that can take this computer. Check that the station is linked to your account.
lanWindow.internet.reason.stationUnavail.chinese: 你的 Remote 账号中没有可供此电脑连接的电台。请确认电台已关联到此账号。

lanWindow.signInHint.english: Sign in with the Nexus Remote account your station is linked to, or one its owner invited to operate it. The station is then on this computer, on its network and over the internet, with no code to type.
lanWindow.signInHint.chinese: 请使用已关联此电台的 Nexus Remote 账号登录，或使用电台所有者邀请你操作电台的账号登录。登录后，无需输入配对码，即可在此电脑上通过本地网络或互联网连接电台。

lanWindow.signIn.where.english: Nexus did not find the station on this network. Type its address as the station shows it under Remote over this network, or its computer’s name.
lanWindow.signIn.where.chinese: Nexus 未在此网络中找到电台。请按电台“通过此网络远程访问”中显示的格式输入地址，或输入电台电脑名称。

lanWindow.signIn.done.english: Signed in. Operate from this computer reaches the station on its network, and over the internet when it is not there.
lanWindow.signIn.done.chinese: 登录成功。“从此电脑操作”会优先通过本地网络连接电台；电台不在此网络时，则通过互联网连接。

lanWindow.signIn.until.english: Signed in with your Nexus Remote account. The station takes this computer on its network until {{date}}.
lanWindow.signIn.until.chinese: 已使用 Nexus Remote 账号登录。此电脑可通过电台所在网络连接至 {{date}}。

lanWindow.signIn.reason.listenOnly.english: You were invited to listen only. Nexus on this computer would operate the station, so it was not added. Listen in your web browser instead.
lanWindow.signIn.reason.listenOnly.chinese: 你获得的邀请仅允许收听，而此电脑上的 Nexus 会控制电台，因此未添加该电台。请改用网页浏览器收听。

lanWindow.signIn.reason.stationNotProven.english: Your station has not signed in to Nexus Remote yet. At the station, press Sign in to Nexus Remote (Settings → Station → Remote access), then try again here.
lanWindow.signIn.reason.stationNotProven.chinese: 电台尚未登录 Nexus Remote。请在电台端点击“登录 Nexus Remote”（设置 → 电台 → 远程访问），然后返回此处重试。

lanWindow.signIn.reason.stationProofFail.english: Nexus could not confirm that the station Nexus Remote lists is yours, so it was not added. Sign in again at the station, then try again here.
lanWindow.signIn.reason.stationProofFail.chinese: Nexus 无法确认 Nexus Remote 列出的电台属于你，因此未添加该电台。请在电台端重新登录，然后返回此处重试。

lanWindow.signIn.reason.stationNotSigned.english: The station is not taking sign-ins on its network. At the station, check that it is signed in to Nexus Remote and that Remote over this network is on.
lanWindow.signIn.reason.stationNotSigned.chinese: 电台当前不接受通过本地网络登录。请在电台端确认已登录 Nexus Remote，并已开启“通过此网络远程访问”。

lanWindow.signIn.reason.proofNotYours.english: The station did not take this sign-in. Sign in with the account the station belongs to, or ask its owner to invite you.
lanWindow.signIn.reason.proofNotYours.chinese: 电台未接受此次登录。请使用电台所属账号登录，或请电台所有者邀请你。

lanWindow.signIn.reason.proofRefused.english: The station could not check this sign-in. Make sure the station and this computer run the same Nexus, then try again.
lanWindow.signIn.reason.proofRefused.chinese: 电台无法验证此次登录。请确认电台和此电脑运行相同版本的 Nexus，然后重试。

lanWindow.away.status.english: Not reached on its own network yet: Operate from this computer uses the internet (Beta). On the station’s network, press Sign in here once to use it there too.
lanWindow.away.status.chinese: 尚未通过电台所在的本地网络连接：当前“从此电脑操作”使用互联网（Beta）。将此电脑接入电台所在网络后，请在此登录一次，以启用本地连接。

lanWindow.away.added.english: Signed in. The station was not found on this network, so it is added over the internet: Operate from this computer uses the internet (Beta) until you sign in here on the station’s network.
lanWindow.away.added.chinese: 登录成功。此网络中未找到电台，因此已通过互联网添加；在你将此电脑接入电台所在网络并在此登录之前，“从此电脑操作”会使用互联网（Beta）。

lanWindow.away.operateConfirm.english: Operate this station from here? Nexus closes and starts again driving it over the internet, and this computer’s own station stays off until you press Leave.
lanWindow.away.operateConfirm.chinese: 要从此电脑操作这台电台吗？Nexus 将关闭并重新启动，改为通过互联网控制远端电台。按下“离开”之前，此电脑本机连接的电台会保持关闭。

client.banner.notLive.english: Not live: the link to the station at {{station}} dropped. The screens show it as it last was, and Nexus connects again by itself.
client.banner.notLive.chinese: 连接已中断：与 {{station}} 电台的连接断开。界面仍显示断开前的状态，Nexus 会自动重新连接。

client.reason.otherBuild.english: Nexus here and at the station are two builds of the same version. Install the same build on both computers.
client.reason.otherBuild.chinese: 此电脑和电台端的 Nexus 版本号相同，但构建版本不同。请在两台电脑上安装相同的构建版本。

client.reason.builds.updateStation.english: This computer runs Nexus {{computer}} and the station runs Nexus {{station}}. Update Nexus at the station to {{computer}}, and this computer connects again by itself.
client.reason.builds.updateStation.chinese: 此电脑运行 Nexus {{computer}}，电台运行 Nexus {{station}}。请将电台端 Nexus 更新至 {{computer}}，之后此电脑会自动重新连接。

client.reason.builds.updateComputer.english: This computer runs Nexus {{computer}} and the station runs Nexus {{station}}. Update Nexus on this computer to {{station}}, and it connects again by itself.
client.reason.builds.updateComputer.chinese: 此电脑运行 Nexus {{computer}}，电台运行 Nexus {{station}}。请将此电脑上的 Nexus 更新至 {{station}}，之后会自动重新连接。

client.reason.builds.otherBuild.english: This computer runs Nexus {{computer}} and the station runs Nexus {{station}}: two builds of the same version. Install the same build on both computers.
client.reason.builds.otherBuild.chinese: 此电脑运行 Nexus {{computer}}，电台运行 Nexus {{station}}：两者版本号相同，但构建版本不同。请在两台电脑上安装相同的构建版本。

client.reason.localPermissionRequired.english: Nexus at the station has not given this computer control. Allow it there.
client.reason.localPermissionRequired.chinese: 电台端的 Nexus 尚未授权此电脑进行控制。请在电台端授予控制权限。

client.banner.internet.notLive.english: Not live: the internet link to the station dropped. The screens show it as it last was, and Nexus connects again by itself.
client.banner.internet.notLive.chinese: 互联网连接已中断：与电台的连接断开。界面仍显示断开前的状态，Nexus 会自动重新连接。

client.banner.takeControl.confirm.english: This ends the other computer’s operating: anything it is transmitting stops now.
client.banner.takeControl.confirm.chinese: 接管后，另一台电脑将立即失去操作权；如果对方正在发射，发射会立即停止。

client.banner.udpBlocked.english: This network lets no audio or second Stop road through: you can watch, tune and log, and transmitting from here is off.
client.banner.udpBlocked.chinese: 此网络无法传输音频或第二条 Stop 安全链路，因此你只能查看、调谐和记录交信，不能从此处发射。

client.reason.notApprovedThere.english: The station has not approved this computer for the internet road, or removed it. Approve it there, or add the road again.
client.reason.notApprovedThere.chinese: 电台尚未批准此电脑通过互联网连接，或已将其移除。请在电台端批准此电脑，或重新添加互联网连接。

client.reason.idle.english: Nobody answered “Still there?”, so the internet link ended.
client.reason.idle.chinese: 无人回应“还在吗？”，互联网连接已断开。

client.reason.internetNotIncluded.english: The internet road is part of Nexus Remote’s paid service, and your account does not include it now. Operating on the station’s own network stays free.
client.reason.internetNotIncluded.chinese: 通过互联网连接属于 Nexus Remote 付费服务，目前你的账号未包含此服务。在电台所在的本地网络中操作仍然免费。

client.over.noWord.english: No word from the station: your over may have ended.
client.over.noWord.chinese: 电台没有回应：你这一轮发射可能已经结束。

client.over.ended.audioGap.english: Your over ended: your audio did not reach the station for 0.2 s.
client.over.ended.audioGap.chinese: 本轮发射已结束：你的音频有 0.2 秒未能传到电台。

client.over.ended.pttGap.english: Your over ended: your PTT did not reach the station for 0.2 s.
client.over.ended.pttGap.chinese: 本轮发射已结束：PTT 信号有 0.2 秒未能传到电台。

client.over.ended.presence.english: Your over ended: the station stopped hearing from this computer.
client.over.ended.presence.chinese: 本轮发射已结束：电台已收不到此电脑的连接信号。

client.over.ended.ceiling.english: Your over ended: it reached the 10-minute limit.
client.over.ended.ceiling.chinese: 本轮发射已结束：已达到 10 分钟上限。

client.over.ended.watchdog.english: Your over ended: the station's TX watchdog stopped it.
client.over.ended.watchdog.chinese: 本轮发射已结束：电台的 TX 看门狗已停止发射。

client.over.ended.routeChanged.english: Your over ended: the station's transmit audio changed.
client.over.ended.routeChanged.chinese: 本轮发射已结束：电台的发射音频路由已更改。

client.refused.noStopRoad.english: Transmitting from here needs the second Stop link to the station, and this connection has none. Nothing was sent.
client.refused.noStopRoad.chinese: 从此处发射需要连接到电台的第二条 Stop 安全链路，但当前连接没有这条链路。未发送任何内容。

client.refused.noPresence.english: The station has not heard this computer’s Stop link in the last 5 seconds, so it takes no transmission from here. Nothing was sent.
client.refused.noPresence.chinese: 电台在过去 5 秒内未收到此电脑的 Stop 链路信号，因此不会接受从此处发起的发射。未发送任何内容。

client.refused.staleState.english: What this screen shows of the station is more than 2 seconds old, so the station takes no transmission from here until it catches up. Nothing was sent.
client.refused.staleState.chinese: 此屏幕显示的电台状态已超过 2 秒未更新。在画面追上实时状态前，电台不会接受从此处发起的发射。未发送任何内容。

client.refused.lockCapped.english: Lock ended at its time limit: nobody answered “Still talking?”. Click PTT to let go, then again to talk.
client.refused.lockCapped.chinese: 发射锁定已达时限：无人回应“还在通话吗？”。请点击 PTT 解除锁定，再次点击即可通话。

client.refused.stopped.english: Transmit was stopped after you pressed this, so the station did not do it. Press it again if you still want it.
client.refused.stopped.chinese: 你按下此按钮后发射已停止，因此电台未执行该操作。如果仍要执行，请再次按下。

client.refused.udpBlocked.english: This network blocks the roads Stop and audio need, so transmitting from here is off. Nothing was sent.
client.refused.udpBlocked.chinese: 此网络阻止了 Stop 和音频所需的链路，因此无法从此处发射。未发送任何内容。

settings.thisComputer.audio.note.english: This computer's own, for the station it operates over this network: kept here, never sent to the station.
settings.thisComputer.audio.note.chinese: 这是此电脑用于操作远端电台的本地音频设置，只保存在此电脑上，不会发送到电台端。

settings.thisComputer.audio.output.hint.english: Where you hear the station's receiver.
settings.thisComputer.audio.output.hint.chinese: 选择此电脑播放电台接收音频的输出设备。

settings.thisComputer.audio.output.troub.english: The audio output would not open: {{why}}
settings.thisComputer.audio.output.troub.chinese: 无法打开音频输出设备：{{why}}

settings.thisComputer.audio.volume.hint.english: How loud the station is heard here, over the level it keeps for its decoders. It changes nothing at the station.
settings.thisComputer.audio.volume.hint.chinese: 调节此电脑播放电台接收音频的音量，不影响电台端为解码器设置的音量，也不会更改电台端的设置。

settings.thisComputer.audio.input.hint.english: What you talk into when you transmit from here. Nexus opens it only while it is needed.
settings.thisComputer.audio.input.hint.chinese: 从此处发射时使用的麦克风。Nexus 只会在需要时启用它。

settings.thisComputer.audio.meter.hint.english: Speak normally: the bar should move well into the middle.
settings.thisComputer.audio.meter.hint.chinese: 按平时通联的音量说话，电平条应明显进入中间区域。

settings.thisComputer.audio.test.failed.english: The test tone could not play.

settings.thisComputer.audio.unavailable.english: This computer's audio did not start, so the station's audio cannot be heard here.
settings.thisComputer.audio.unavailable.chinese: 此电脑的音频设备未能启动，因此无法在此收听电台音频。

settings.thisComputer.audio.notKept.english: This computer could not keep that choice. Try again.
settings.thisComputer.audio.notKept.chinese: 此电脑未能保存该选择。请重试。

settings.station.fdOperator.hint.english: Only for multi-operator: the callsign of whoever is operating, when that is not the station call. Stamped on every contact you log (ADIF OPERATOR) so a shared activation can be split per operator — POTA and Field Day both want each operator to submit their own. Blank means single-op and nothing is stamped. Change it when you swap seats.
settings.station.fdOperator.hint.chinese: 仅供多人操作时使用：当实际操作员的呼号与本台呼号不同时，在此填写该操作员的呼号。该呼号会写入每条交信记录的 ADIF OPERATOR 字段，以便多人共同进行 POTA 或 Field Day 活动时区分各自的交信，并由每位操作员分别提交。留空表示单人操作，不写入该字段；更换操作员时请相应更新。

settings.station.opState.hint.english: Your US state or province, for everyday contacts — the CW {MYSTATE} macro and the QTH an RTTY ragchew sends. A contest uses its own box, Contesting ▸ Your station data ▸ State or province, so a portable or mobile entry can differ from this one.
settings.station.opState.hint.chinese: 填写你所在的美国州或加拿大省，用于日常交信、CW {MYSTATE} 宏以及 RTTY 闲聊通联中发送的 QTH 信息。参加竞赛时，请填写“竞赛 → 本台信息 → 州或省”中的独立字段，因此便携或移动操作时可与此处不同。

settings.station.licenseClass.hint.english: Sets your transmit privileges + the licensed-segment band dropdown. Open = no limits (outside the US).
settings.station.licenseClass.hint.chinese: 此设置用于确定你的发射权限，并筛选执照允许使用的频段。选择“开放”表示不限制发射（美国以外地区）。

settings.station.grid.hint.english: Maidenhead locator. All 6 characters — 4 measures every distance and bearing from the middle of a ~100-mile square.
settings.station.grid.hint.chinese: Maidenhead 网格定位格式，请填写全部 6 个字符。前 4 个字符确定约 100 英里（160 公里）见方的网格，距离和方位均以该网格中心为基准。

settings.station.fdOperator.placeholder.english: leave blank if that is you
settings.station.fdOperator.placeholder.chinese: 若由你本人操作，请留空

client.banner.signingAgain.english: Signing in again, so this computer keeps operating the station on its network: finish in your web browser.
client.banner.signingAgain.chinese: 正在重新登录，以便此电脑继续通过本地网络操作电台。请在浏览器中完成登录。

client.banner.signInBy.english: Sign in again by {{date}} in Stations on this network to keep operating this station on its network.
client.banner.signInBy.chinese: 请于 {{date}} 前在“此网络上的电台”中重新登录，以继续通过本地网络操作此电台。

client.over.gaps::one.chinese: 发射音频中断 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒

client.over.gaps::other.chinese: 发射音频中断 {{count}} 次，共 {{seconds}} 秒

client.over.ended.stopped.english: Your over ended: it was stopped at the station.
client.over.ended.stopped.chinese: 本轮发射已结束：电台端已停止发射。

client.over.ended.refused.english: The station did not take your PTT.
client.over.ended.refused.chinese: 电台未接受你的 PTT 信号。

client.bench.blockStopRoad.chinese: 阻断 Stop 安全链路

client.bench.blocked.stopRoad.english: Test build: this computer is blocking its Stop road to the station.
client.bench.blocked.stopRoad.chinese: 测试版本：此电脑正在阻断连接到电台的 Stop 安全链路。

gettingStarted.station.lede.english: Your callsign and your grid square. Everything location-shaped in Nexus — the propagation map, satellite passes, distances, bearings, DXpedition windows, VHF opening locality — is computed from these two fields.
gettingStarted.station.lede.chinese: 填写呼号和网格定位。Nexus 中所有与位置有关的信息——传播地图、卫星过境、距离、方位、DX 远征活动窗口和 VHF 开通区域——都根据这两项计算。

gettingStarted.station.callsign.english: Callsign — stored uppercase. Nexus will not start PSK Reporter or the RBN/cluster feed until a valid one is set: 3–10 characters, at least one letter and one digit.
gettingStarted.station.callsign.chinese: 呼号——保存时会转换为大写。必须先填写有效呼号（3–10 个字符，至少包含一个字母和一个数字），Nexus 才会启动 PSK Reporter 或 RBN/电台通报源。

gettingStarted.station.grid.english: Grid square — your Maidenhead locator. QRZ shows yours.
gettingStarted.station.grid.chinese: 网格定位——你的 Maidenhead 网格定位符，可在 QRZ 上查询。

gettingStarted.station.name.english: Name — optional, in Settings ▸ Station. Feeds the CW {NAME} macro and logbook autofill.
gettingStarted.station.name.chinese: 姓名——可选，在“设置 → 电台”中填写。此姓名会用于 CW {NAME} 宏和日志自动填充。

gettingStarted.station.callout.body.english: Four characters pins you to the middle of a ~100-mile square, and every distance and bearing you will ever read is measured from that point. {{full}} beats {{short}}. A malformed locator is refused outright — the wizard will not let you past it.
gettingStarted.station.callout.body.chinese: 只填 4 个字符时，系统会把你定位在约 100 英里见方网格的中心；之后显示的距离和方位都以该点为基准。填写完整的 {{full}} 比 {{short}} 更准确。网格定位格式错误时会被拒绝，无法继续向导。

gettingStarted.station.shot.sub.english: Your grid square is the anchor for everything location-based — satellite passes, propagation, the map, and DXpedition windows are all computed from it.
gettingStarted.station.shot.sub.chinese: 网格定位是所有位置相关信息的基准：卫星过境、传播情况、地图和 DX 远征活动窗口均由此计算。

gettingStarted.station.shot.gridHint.english: Maidenhead locator (qrz.com shows yours). Give all 6 — 4 characters pins you to the middle of a ~100-mile square.
gettingStarted.station.shot.gridHint.chinese: Maidenhead 网格定位符（可在 qrz.com 查询）。请填写全部 6 个字符；只填 4 个字符会将位置设为约 100 英里见方网格的中心。

gettingStarted.radio.lede.english: One button does the archaeology. Nexus reads the USB descriptors, matches the rig model, pairs the audio CODEC, and looks for FlexRadios on your network — in a single scan.
gettingStarted.radio.lede.chinese: 点击一次即可自动检测设备。Nexus 会读取 USB 设备信息、匹配电台型号、配对音频编解码器，并扫描网络中的 FlexRadio 电台。

gettingStarted.radio.where.english: In the wizard, or in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Rig & CAT, click Detect my radio.
gettingStarted.radio.where.chinese: 在设置向导中，或前往 设置 → 电台 → 电台设备与 CAT，点击 检测我的电台。

gettingStarted.radio.pickRow.english: Pick the row that is your radio. It fills the port, the Hamlib model and both audio devices at once. On a dual-UART Icom two rows describe the same rig — take the one tagged CI-V port — use this one.
gettingStarted.radio.pickRow.chinese: 选择对应你电台的那一行。系统会一次填入端口、Hamlib 型号以及音频输入和输出设备。双 UART 的 Icom 电台可能会显示两行；请选择标有 CI-V 端口——使用此项 的那一行。

gettingStarted.radio.genericCable.english: Generic cable? A CH340 reporting only “USB Serial” fills the port and audio but leaves the model blank — choose it from the dropdown.
gettingStarted.radio.genericCable.chinese: 使用通用线缆？如果 CH340 设备只显示为“USB Serial”，检测结果会填入端口和音频设备，但电台型号仍为空；请从下拉菜单中选择型号。

gettingStarted.radio.flex.english: FlexRadio is found on the network and configured the WSJT-X-proven way: CAT through the SmartSDR CAT app at 127.0.0.1:5002, audio through DAX.
gettingStarted.radio.flex.chinese: FlexRadio 会通过网络自动发现，并按 WSJT-X 常用方式配置：CAT 通过 SmartSDR CAT 应用连接到 127.0.0.1:5002，音频则通过 DAX 传输。

gettingStarted.radio.testCat.english: Then press Test CAT. Nexus saves what you entered, starts rigctld for the radio, and reports the dial frequency it read back — or the specific error. Other programs share the radio through the address in Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Transmit limits & sharing.
gettingStarted.radio.testCat.chinese: 然后点击“测试 CAT”。Nexus 会保存你填写的设置、启动电台对应的 rigctld，并显示读取到的拨盘频率或具体错误。其他软件可通过“设置 → 电台 → 发射限制与共享”中的地址共享电台。

gettingStarted.radio.callout.body.english: USB: plug it in and power it on. Flex: it has to be on this network. Either way you can skip and set it up later — the wizard never blocks on hardware. Set Tx Level (default 0.9) down until your rig’s ALC reads zero before you transmit.
gettingStarted.radio.callout.body.chinese: USB 电台：连接线缆并开机。FlexRadio：确保它接入此网络。你也可以先跳过，稍后再设置；向导不会因尚未连接硬件而阻止继续。发射前，请调低 Tx Level（默认值为 0.9），直到电台的 ALC 显示为零。

gettingStarted.radio.shot.captionMac.english: Setup wizard ▸ step 2 · CAT needs Homebrew Hamlib — in Terminal: brew install hamlib
gettingStarted.radio.shot.captionMac.chinese: 设置向导 → 第 2 步 · CAT 需要通过 Homebrew 安装 Hamlib。在终端中运行：brew install hamlib

gettingStarted.radio.shot.sub.english: One detect finds everything — USB rigs and FlexRadios on the network. Skippable; Settings ▸ Radio ▸ Rig & CAT has all of this later.
gettingStarted.radio.shot.sub.chinese: 一次检测即可查找 USB 电台和网络中的 FlexRadio。此步骤可以跳过，之后可在“设置 → 电台 → 电台设备与 CAT”中完成配置。

gettingStarted.radio.shot.netBlurb.english: SDR software, or a remote rig

gettingStarted.radio.shot.testCatResult.chinese: ✓ 电台已通过 {{port}} 响应——拨盘频率为 {{dial}}

gettingStarted.license.aria.chinese: 第 3 步，共 4 步：执照等级

gettingStarted.license.eyebrow.chinese: 第 3 步，共 4 步 · 你的执照

gettingStarted.license.heading.english: Declare your class, get a real lockout
gettingStarted.license.heading.chinese: 选择执照等级，启用实际发射限制

gettingStarted.license.lede.english: This one field becomes a software guard in every transmit path in the app. Nexus parks the dial in your licensed segments and refuses to key up outside them, with a toast that says why.
gettingStarted.license.lede.chinese: 此项设置会在应用的所有发射路径中启用软件限制。Nexus 会将拨盘频率限制在执照允许的频段范围内，并拒绝在范围外发射，同时说明原因。

gettingStarted.license.where.english: On the wizard’s last step, under What’s your license?. It is persisted the moment you click it.
gettingStarted.license.where.chinese: 在设置向导最后一步的 你的执照等级 中选择。点击选项后会立即保存。

gettingStarted.license.technician.english: A Technician on 40 m is held to the CW segment — phone and FT8 TX outside it are blocked.
gettingStarted.license.technician.chinese: 美国 Technician 等级在 40 m 频段只能在 CW 频段范围内发射；超出该范围的语音和 FT8 发射会被阻止。

gettingStarted.license.general.english: A General on 20 m cannot transmit in the Extra-only portion at the low end.
gettingStarted.license.general.chinese: 美国 General 等级不能在 20 m 频段低端仅限 Extra 等级使用的频段内发射。

gettingStarted.license.sixty.english: The channelized 60 m segments are included.
gettingStarted.license.sixty.chinese: 也包含按信道划分的 60 m 频段。

gettingStarted.license.outsideUs.english: Outside the US? Pick Outside the US. The lockout models US FCC Part 97 / ITU Region 2 only, so it is off rather than wrong.
gettingStarted.license.outsideUs.chinese: 如果你不在美国，请选择 美国以外。发射限制仅依据美国 FCC Part 97 和 ITU 第 2 区规则，因此在美国以外会关闭限制，而不会套用错误的规则。

gettingStarted.license.callout.body.english: You are responsible for knowing your privileges. The lockout catches the slip; it does not replace the knowledge. A fresh install defaults to Open, so nothing is silently restricted before you say so.
gettingStarted.license.callout.body.chinese: 你有责任了解自己的执照权限。发射限制可以拦截误操作，但不能代替你了解相关规则。全新安装默认选择 开放，不会在你设置前悄悄限制发射。

gettingStarted.license.shot.sub.english: Sets your transmit privileges — the app parks the dial in your licensed band segments and won’t let you transmit outside them. Pick “Outside the US” for no limits.
gettingStarted.license.shot.sub.chinese: 设置发射权限：应用会将拨盘频率限制在执照允许的频段范围内，并阻止超范围发射。美国以外的用户请选择“美国以外”，不启用频段限制。

gettingStarted.license.shot.toast.english: TX blocked — {{freq}} is outside your General phone privileges on 40 m.
gettingStarted.license.shot.toast.chinese: 发射已阻止——{{freq}} 超出你在 40 m 频段的 General 语音发射权限。

gettingStarted.log.lede.english: One log, every mode. Import one ADIF file and the app knows every station you have already worked, every entity you still need, and exactly how far you are from your next award — on digital, phone and CW alike, computed offline from your own history.
gettingStarted.log.lede.chinese: 一份日志适用于所有模式。导入 ADIF 文件后，应用便能识别已通联过的电台、尚未完成的实体，以及距离下一个奖项还有多少进度；数字、语音和 CW 模式均可使用，所有结果都根据本地日志离线计算。

gettingStarted.log.without.body.english: Every callsign looks the same, whether it arrives as a decode, a cluster spot or a voice on the band. Every station is new. The Needed board has nothing to say.
gettingStarted.log.without.body.chinese: 无论呼号来自解码结果、电台通报还是频段上的语音通联，应用都无法判断你是否联系过对方。每个电台看起来都像新电台，“待通联”面板也无法提供提示。

gettingStarted.log.b4.body.english: B4 chips wherever a callsign appears — digital decodes, the Call Roster, spots, and the recall card in the Phone and CW cockpits.
gettingStarted.log.b4.body.chinese: 呼号旁会显示 B4 标记，包括数字模式解码、呼号列表、电台通报，以及语音和 CW 操作界面的回忆卡片。

gettingStarted.log.needed.body.english: New DXCC, new state, new grid, new band slot — ranked across every band and mode at once, with the evidence that says it is workable now.
gettingStarted.log.needed.body.chinese: 按优先级列出尚未完成的 DXCC 实体、州、网格和频段/模式组合，并显示当前可进行通联的依据。
