gettingStarted.log.awards.body.english: DXCC, Challenge, Honor Roll, WAS, WAZ, VUCC and IOTA — mode-agnostic and per-mode alike — the moment the import finishes.
gettingStarted.log.awards.body.chinese: 导入完成后即可查看 DXCC、Challenge、Honor Roll、WAS、WAZ、VUCC 和 IOTA 等奖项进度，包括不区分模式和按模式统计的进度。

gettingStarted.log.sources.intro.english: Any standard ADIF export — .adi or .adif. If you have been operating, you already have one.
gettingStarted.log.sources.intro.chinese: 支持任何标准 ADIF 导出文件：.adi 或 .adif。只要你进行过通联，通常就已经有这样的文件。

gettingStarted.log.sources.others.english: N1MM+, Log4OM, HRD, ClubLog — export ADIF from the logbook.
gettingStarted.log.sources.others.chinese: N1MM+、Log4OM、HRD、ClubLog——从日志软件中导出 ADIF 文件。

gettingStarted.log.import.body.english: Wizard step 3, or Logbook ▸ Import ADIF at any time. Import as many files as you like — duplicates are detected and skipped, so a second pass costs you nothing.
gettingStarted.log.import.body.chinese: 可在向导第 3 步导入，也可随时前往 日志 → 导入 ADIF。可以导入多个文件；重复记录会自动识别并跳过，重复导入不会产生额外影响。

gettingStarted.log.callout.body.english: The import is local. Your log lives in log.adi on your own machine, and the awards engine computes against it offline. Uploading to LoTW, QRZ, ClubLog or eQSL is a separate, opt-in connector.
gettingStarted.log.callout.body.chinese: 导入在本机完成。日志保存在你电脑上的 log.adi 文件中，奖项进度也会离线计算。上传至 LoTW、QRZ、ClubLog 或 eQSL 属于单独的连接器功能，需要你主动启用。

gettingStarted.log.shot.formats.english: From WSJT-X, N1MM, Log4OM, HRD, QRZ, LoTW, ClubLog — any standard ADIF (.adi/.adif) export. Nothing leaves your computer; duplicates are detected and skipped.
gettingStarted.log.shot.formats.chinese: 支持从 WSJT-X、N1MM、Log4OM、HRD、QRZ、LoTW、ClubLog 等软件导出的标准 ADIF（.adi/.adif）文件。数据不会离开你的电脑；重复记录会自动识别并跳过。

gettingStarted.log.closing.digital.english: Open Digital. The dial starts on {{freq}} and the decoder runs every 15-second slot — there is no Monitor toggle to forget.
gettingStarted.log.closing.digital.chinese: 打开 数字模式。拨盘会调到 {{freq}}，解码器每个 15 秒时隙都会运行，无需手动开启 Monitor。

gettingStarted.log.closing.decodes.english: Within a period or two, decodes fill Band Activity — now annotated with country, B4 and New / DXCC badges, because you imported the log.
gettingStarted.log.closing.decodes.chinese: 一两个周期后，解码结果就会显示在“频段活动”中。由于已导入日志，结果还会标注国家/地区、B4，以及 新呼号/DXCC 等状态。

gettingStarted.log.closing.doubleClick.english: Double-click a station calling CQ. The sequencer runs the whole exchange and logs it. The same log feeds the Phone and CW cockpits, so a familiar call shows their name and your history there too.
gettingStarted.log.closing.doubleClick.chinese: 双击正在呼叫 CQ 的电台，通联流程会自动完成交信并记入日志。同一份日志也供语音和 CW 操作界面使用，因此熟悉的呼号会显示对方姓名和以往通联记录。

gettingStarted.wsjtx.body.english: Your muscle memory transfers — double-click semantics, Esc / F4 / F6 / Alt+1–6, Band Activity bottom-pinned, early decodes at 11.8 s, Fake-It split, Hound auto-move. So do your settings: point step 2 at the same rig and audio devices WSJT-X uses, and hand step 4 your wsjtx_log.adi. JTAlert and GridTracker keep working once you turn on WSJT-X UDP API (off by default) in Settings ▸ Logging & Connectors ▸ Integrations & Feeds. Its address already matches WSJT-X’s default, so nothing else needs setting, and they see Nexus as a WSJT-X.
gettingStarted.wsjtx.body.chinese: 你熟悉的操作方式也适用：双击操作、Esc / F4 / F6 / Alt+1–6 快捷键、固定在底部的“频段活动”、11.8 s 的提前解码、Fake-It 频率分离和 Hound 自动切换。设置也可以沿用：第 2 步选择 WSJT-X 使用的电台和音频设备，第 4 步导入 wsjtx_log.adi。在“设置 → 日志与连接器 → 集成与数据源”中启用默认关闭的 WSJT-X UDP API 后，JTAlert 和 GridTracker 也可继续使用。其地址与 WSJT-X 默认地址相同，无需另行设置；这两个软件会将 Nexus 识别为 WSJT-X。

gettingStarted.wsjtx.mac.english: On a Mac, hold Fn for the F-keys — or turn on "Use F1, F2, etc. keys as standard function keys" in System Settings ▸ Keyboard, as with WSJT-X.
gettingStarted.wsjtx.mac.chinese: 在 Mac 上，按住 Fn 再按 F 键；或者像使用 WSJT-X 时一样，在“系统设置 → 键盘”中启用“将 F1、F2 等键用作标准功能键”。

assist.toggle.declare.chinese: 将参赛日志声明为非辅助组

assist.why.summary.english: What this means for your contest category
assist.why.summary.chinese: 这会如何影响你的竞赛组别

assist.why.cqww.english: CQ WW rule VIII.2 counts “a CW decoder, DX cluster, DX spotting Web sites … local or remote call sign and frequency decoding technology (e.g., CW Skimmer or Reverse Beacon Network)” as QSO-finding assistance. Using any of them places the entry in Single Operator Assisted (V.A.2) instead of Single Operator (V.A.1).
assist.why.cqww.chinese: CQ WW 规则 VIII.2 将“CW 解码器、DX 集群、DX 通报网站……本地或远程呼号及频率解码技术（例如 CW Skimmer 或 Reverse Beacon Network）”列为寻找 QSO 的辅助工具。使用其中任何一项，都应归入 Single Operator Assisted（V.A.2），而不是 Single Operator（V.A.1）。

assist.why.arrl.english: ARRL contests call it spotting assistance and name “PSKReporter, Telnet, DX spotting websites or bulletin board systems, automated multi-channel decoders”. Single Operator may not use it (HCAT.1.1: “Use of spotting assistance is not permitted.”). Single Operator Unlimited may (HCAT.2.1). ARRL’s glossary defines a multi-channel decoder as software that “displays multiple decoded signals at the same time”. Nexus decodes one signal at a time, so that definition does not describe its CW decoder. It does describe the cluster, RBN and PSK Reporter feeds.
assist.why.arrl.chinese: ARRL 竞赛将其称为“通报辅助”，列举了 PSKReporter、Telnet、DX 通报网站或公告板系统，以及自动多信道解码器。Single Operator 组不得使用此类辅助（HCAT.1.1：“不允许使用通报辅助。”）；Single Operator Unlimited 组可以使用（HCAT.2.1）。ARRL 术语表将多信道解码器定义为“同时显示多个已解码信号的软件”。Nexus 的 CW 解码器一次只解码一个信号，因此不属于该定义；DX 集群、RBN 和 PSK Reporter 数据源则属于。

assist.why.ownDecodes.english: Your radio’s own digital decodes, FT8 and FT4 among them, keep feeding the Needed board in unassisted mode. Neither ruleset sets them apart: both count any technology that identifies a callsign or multiplier as assistance, so do not use the Needed board to find stations if your contest counts them. Your outbound PSK Reporter uploads also keep running, because ARRL says “Generating spotting information for use by other stations is not considered to be spotting assistance.”
assist.why.ownDecodes.chinese: 在非辅助模式下，电台自身产生的数字模式解码（包括 FT8 和 FT4）仍会更新“待通联”面板。两套规则都没有将其排除在外：凡是能识别呼号或系数的技术都可能被视为辅助。如果你参加的竞赛将其计为辅助，请勿用“待通联”面板寻找电台。Nexus 仍会向外上传 PSK Reporter 信息，因为 ARRL 规定：“生成供其他电台使用的通报信息不视为通报辅助。”

assist.why.notCovered.english: What this switch does not cover: POTA and SOTA activator spots still arrive. Neither ruleset names those feeds, but both define assistance broadly enough to include them, so switch off the POTA/SOTA features by hand if you are entering a contest that counts them.
assist.why.notCovered.chinese: 此开关不控制以下来源：POTA 和 SOTA 激活通报仍会接收。两套规则虽然没有明确列出这些数据源，但对辅助的定义都足以涵盖它们。如果所参加的竞赛将其计为辅助，请手动关闭 POTA/SOTA 功能。

assist.why.checkRules.english: Rules differ by contest and change between years, so check the rules of the contest you are entering. This note reports what CQ WW and ARRL currently publish. It is not a category ruling.
assist.why.checkRules.chinese: 不同竞赛的规则各不相同，也可能逐年变化，因此请查阅你所参加竞赛的现行规则。此说明仅概述 CQ WW 和 ARRL 当前公布的规则，不构成对参赛组别的正式裁定。

assist.keep.english: Your own settings are never rewritten. Ending unassisted mode restores the decoder and feeds exactly as you had them.
assist.keep.chinese: 此功能不会改写你的设置。退出非辅助模式后，解码器和数据源会完全恢复到之前的状态。

Tick the ones to change. Nothing changes until you press the button, and nothing is uploaded again. A confirmed contact starts unticked.
logbook.parkStates.intro.chinese: 这些公园或山峰通联记录中的州信息与所在地不符，或未填写州信息。旧版 Nexus 可能会根据激活者执照或呼号资料，将其居住州记入日志。请勾选要更正的记录。点击更改按钮前不会修改任何内容，也不会再次上传。已确认的交信默认不勾选。

logbook.confirmations.intro.english: Earlier versions of Nexus could put the confirmation of one contact, from LoTW, eQSL or QRZ, or the mark that LoTW holds its upload, on another contact with the same station, band and mode on the same UTC day. Check downloads your whole history once from each of these services you have set up, which can take several minutes for LoTW, and lists each contact holding a confirmation or upload mark that the service’s own records give another contact, or none. A line starts ticked only when those records decide it. Nothing changes until you press the button, nothing is uploaded, and no paper card is touched.
logbook.confirmations.intro.chinese: 旧版 Nexus 可能会把 LoTW、eQSL 或 QRZ 对某条交信的确认，或 LoTW 的上传标记，错误地记到同一 UTC 日期内电台、频段和模式相同的另一条交信上。点击“检查”会从已配置的各项服务下载完整历史记录；LoTW 可能需要几分钟。随后会列出服务记录显示确认或上传标记实际属于其他交信、或无法匹配到交信的记录。只有证据足以判定时，条目才会默认勾选。点击更改按钮前不会修改任何内容，不会上传数据，也不会更改纸质卡片的记录。

roam.disclaimer.english: Not private — announced in the clear. Coordinated QSY steps you and one other station to a new channel together, with the move sent as plain text (FCC Part 97 forbids encryption / obscured meaning, and your callsign IDs every 10 min). It shakes a casual scanner parked on the old frequency — it does not hide you from anyone with a wideband receiver, who can follow. Use it for anti-QRM and modest obscurity, never for secrecy.
roam.disclaimer.chinese: 不具备私密性，切频信息以明文公告。协同 QSY 让本台与另一电台一起切换到新信道，切频安排以明文发送（FCC Part 97 禁止加密或掩盖通信含义，并且每 10 分钟发送一次本台呼号标识）。这可以甩开停留在原频率上的普通扫描监听者，但不能阻止使用宽带接收机的人跟随监听。此功能用于避开干扰、减少随意监听，不可用于保密通信。

settings.pounce.note.english: Interrupts you the INSTANT a needed station appears on the cluster or RBN, rather than waiting for the spot board to refresh. A loud tone plays whether or not Nexus is the window you are looking at, and a banner offers one-click Work. Off until you switch it on. How rare "rare" is depends on your own totals: if you are chasing your first hundred entities then almost every DX spot is a new one and this would never stop talking. Start with New DXCC entity only once your log is far enough along that a new one is genuinely an event. Each station alerts once per band and mode.
settings.pounce.note.chinese: 集群或 RBN 一出现待通联目标就立即提醒，不必等待通报面板刷新。无论 Nexus 是否为当前窗口，都会播放响亮提示音，并显示可一键通联的横幅。默认关闭，需手动启用。“稀有”与否取决于本台已有的通联成果：如果还在积累最初的 100 个实体，几乎每条 DX 通报都是新目标，提醒可能响个不停。建议等日志积累到新实体确实少见时，再从仅限新 DXCC 实体开始使用。每个电台在每个频段和模式上只提醒一次。

sat.log.note.english: Logs the contact from your dial, exactly as the Phone and CW log panels do. On the downlink of a satellite LoTW lists — the one you are working, or the one you last worked until you pick another — Nexus tags it for you: it writes the ADIF PROP_MODE and SAT_NAME fields, so the contact counts toward LoTW satellite credit and Nexus’s own satellite totals. Anything else is logged as an ordinary contact, and on 2 m its grid counts toward your terrestrial VUCC, which a satellite contact does not earn. To tag one yourself, add both fields — one without the other is refused at signing.
sat.log.note.chinese: 按电台当前调谐频率记录交信，方式与话音和 CW 日志面板相同。如果当前处于 LoTW 所列卫星的下行频率上（正在通联的卫星，或在选定另一颗之前最近使用的卫星），Nexus 会自动写入 ADIF 的 PROP_MODE 和 SAT_NAME 字段，使该交信可计入 LoTW 卫星奖项认可，也计入 Nexus 自身的卫星统计。其他情况按普通交信记录；在 2 米频段，其网格会计入地面通信 VUCC，而卫星交信不能计入该项。若自行标记卫星交信，须同时填写这两个字段，缺少其中任一字段都会在签名时被拒绝。
sat.log.note.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

Each radio has its OWN CAT + audio — click “Edit” on any radio to configure it WITHOUT changing the one you're operating on; “Make active” swaps your operating radio. settings.routing.intro.english: Route by band AND mode — band coverage above sends a whole band to one radio. Add rules here when TWO radios share a band and the MODE decides which one: 2 m FT8 to the digital rig, 2 m FM and APRS to the FM rig. Rules are checked top to bottom and the FIRST match wins; anything no rule matches falls back to band coverage, then to the default radio.

settings.rigControl.pttPort.hint.english: COM port your RTS/DTR keying line is on — e.g. an SO2R controller (u2R/MK2R) that routes PTT on its own port, separate from CAT. Leave blank if keying shares the CAT port, which is how a single-cable interface like a Digirig Mobile is wired; CAT keeps working either way. Per radio: each rig on an SO2R box has its own keying port, and this one follows the radio you switch to.
settings.rigControl.pttPort.hint.chinese: RTS／DTR 键控线所在的 COM 端口。例如 SO2R 控制器（u2R／MK2R）可能使用独立于 CAT 的端口控制 PTT。如果键控与 CAT 共用端口，请留空，Digirig Mobile 等单线接口通常如此连接。无论是否共用端口，CAT 都会继续工作。按电台分别设置：SO2R 控制器上的每台电台都有各自的键控端口，此设置会随当前电台切换。

settings.rigControl.catRts.hint.english: Tick this if your interface keys the radio from the CAT port’s RTS line — a Digirig Mobile and most other one-cable interfaces are wired this way. Nexus then holds RTS down, instead of leaving it up where it puts some rigs into transmit the moment the port opens. If your radio transmits as soon as Nexus starts, this is the setting. Leave it off if a plain serial cable goes straight to the radio: the radio may be using that line for flow control, and taking it away can cost you CAT.
settings.rigControl.catRts.hint.chinese: 如果接口通过 CAT 端口的 RTS 线触发电台发射，请勾选此项；Digirig Mobile 和大多数其他单线接口采用这种接线。Nexus 会将 RTS 保持在未置位状态，避免端口打开时因 RTS 置位而让某些电台立即发射。如果 Nexus 一启动电台就发射，请检查此设置。若只用普通串口线直连电台，请保持关闭；电台可能将该线用于流量控制，强制改变其状态可能导致 CAT 失效。

settings.rigControl.conn.hint.english: Serial for a rig on a USB/COM port (most rigs, including Xiegu). Network for anything serving CAT over TCP: an SDR program on this PC (Thetis, PowerSDR, SmartSDR CAT, piHPSDR), or a remote rigctld. TCI for an SDR program's own TCI server (ExpertSDR3, Thetis, piHPSDR), with no Rig Model to pick. The Rig Model still picks which CAT dialect is spoken — for an SDR, choose the program you launched, not the board inside the radio. An Icom on its LAN port needs a program in between, because Icom's network protocol is its own: with wfview, turn on its rigctld server and point Nexus at it with Network and Rig Model NET rigctl; with RS-BA1, choose Serial, your Icom's own model and the virtual COM port RS-BA1 creates.
settings.rigControl.conn.hint.chinese: USB／COM 端口连接的电台（包括 Xiegu 在内的大多数电台）请选择串口。通过 TCP 提供 CAT 的设备请选择网络，例如本机 SDR 程序（Thetis、PowerSDR、SmartSDR CAT、piHPSDR）或远程 rigctld。连接 SDR 程序自身的 TCI 服务器（ExpertSDR3、Thetis、piHPSDR）请选择 TCI，无需选择电台型号。其他连接中的 电台型号仍用于确定 CAT 协议：使用 SDR 时，应选择正在运行的程序，而非电台内部的硬件板卡。Icom 的 LAN 端口采用专有网络协议，需要中间程序：使用 wfview 时，开启其 rigctld 服务器，在 Nexus 中选择网络连接，并将型号设为 NET rigctl；使用 RS-BA1 时，选择串口、Icom 实际型号及 RS-BA1 创建的虚拟 COM 端口。
settings.rigControl.conn.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.rigControl.netAddr.hint.english: host:port. For a Flex: the WSJT-X-proven path is the SmartSDR CAT app on THIS PC — its DEFAULT TCP port 5002 is directed at slice A, so 127.0.0.1:5002 with the FLEX-6xxx / 8xxx model works out of the box; audio rides DAX. Multi-slice: SmartSDR CAT's per-slice ports are B=60001, C=60002, D=60003 — Nexus drives ONE slice, so enter the port of the slice you run digital on. (Direct-to-radio :4992 needs Hamlib's experimental native model and failed on real hardware.) Other rigs: a remote rigctld's host:port with their normal model.
settings.rigControl.netAddr.hint.chinese: 格式为主机:端口。Flex 可使用已在 WSJT-X 中验证的路径：本机 SmartSDR CAT 程序默认将 TCP 5002 指向接收切片 A，因此使用 127.0.0.1:5002 配合 FLEX-6xxx / 8xxx 型号即可，音频经 DAX 传输。多接收切片时，SmartSDR CAT 对应端口为 B=60001、C=60002、D=60003。Nexus 仅控制一个切片，请填写用于数字通信的切片端口。（直接连接电台 :4992 需要 Hamlib 实验性原生型号，实际硬件测试未成功。）其他电台填写远程 rigctld 的主机:端口，并选择其常规型号。

settings.rigControl.split.hint.chinese: 以 500 Hz 为步进调整发射调谐频率，将发射音频保持在 1500–2000 Hz，使音频谐波落在发射滤波器之外，获得更纯净的信号。Rig 使用 VFO B 异频；Fake It 在每轮发射前后重调 VFO，适用于所有支持 CAT 的电台；None 沿用 WSJT-X 默认方式，按原始音频偏移发射。

settings.rigControl.plainSsb.label.chinese: 数据模式使用普通 SSB
settings.rigControl.plainSsb.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.rigControl.plainSsb.hint.english: Leave this off unless you know you need it. Nexus normally puts the radio in its DATA submode (DATA-U / USB-D / PKTUSB) for FT8, FT4, RTTY-AFSK and SSTV, because on most rigs that is the only mode where the USB codec reaches the transmitter. Turn this on and Nexus commands plain USB/LSB for those modes instead, and stays there — through band changes and when you call a station. Correct if your transmit audio goes in the microphone path, as with an interface wired to the mic jack (some RIGblaster models) — or if you simply prefer plain USB to the DATA submode (for its wider receive passband, say) and your rig is set to send its USB-codec audio in SSB, which on many modern rigs (FT-991A, IC-7300 and the like) is a single menu item. Either way the rig has to put the audio you're feeding onto the air in plain SSB: where it does not — the codec feeds only the data port and nothing carries in SSB — plain SSB takes audio from the mic and the radio transmits no RF at all, a red TX light and nothing on the air. Per radio, since it depends on how that rig is cabled and set. True FSK RTTY is unaffected — it keeps the rig's own RTTY mode.
settings.rigControl.plainSsb.hint.chinese: 除非明确需要，否则请保持关闭。Nexus 通常为 FT8、FT4、RTTY-AFSK 和 SSTV 选择电台的 DATA 子模式（DATA-U／USB-D／PKTUSB），因为多数电台只有在该模式下才会将 USB 音频送入发射机。开启后，这些模式改用普通 USB/LSB，切换频段或呼叫电台时也保持不变。如果发射音频通过话筒通道输入，例如接在话筒插座上的部分 RIGblaster 接口，则适合开启。若偏好普通 USB 而非 DATA 子模式，例如为了更宽的接收通带，也可开启，但必须先将电台设为在 SSB 下发送 USB 音频；FT-991A、IC-7300 等现代电台通常可用一个菜单项设置。无论哪种情况，普通 SSB 下都必须能将所输入的音频送入发射。如果 USB 音频只进入数据端口，而 SSB 仍取话筒音频，则会出现 TX 灯亮却完全没有射频输出的情况。按电台分别设置，取决于接线和设备设置。真正的 FSK RTTY 不受影响，仍使用电台自身的 RTTY 模式。

settings.rigControl.sstvHoldData.label.chinese: SSTV 接收期间保持数据模式
settings.rigControl.sstvHoldData.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.rigControl.sstvHoldData.hint.english: Keeps this radio in the data submode for the whole time the SSTV receiver is running, instead of only while a picture is queued or going out — FM-D / DATA-FM on an FM channel, and USB-D / LSB-D on HF. Off by default, which is what Nexus does today: it commands the data submode around a send and puts the radio back in plain FM or SSB in between, so a rig parked on an SSTV calling channel keeps dropping out of the data mode. That revert is deliberate — an SSTV send once keyed a data mode into an FM repeater input — but it is the wrong answer if you sit on an SSTV calling channel for the evening. Stop the receiver before you go back to voice. The receiver keeps running after you leave the SSTV screen, and while it runs this radio is held in the data submode, where transmit audio comes from the data port and your microphone modulates nothing. Per radio, since it depends on how that rig is cabled and what you use it for.
settings.rigControl.sstvHoldData.hint.chinese: SSTV 接收器运行的整个期间，都让这台电台保持在数据子模式，而非仅在图片排队或发送时使用。FM 信道采用 FM-D／DATA-FM，短波采用 USB-D／LSB-D。默认关闭，沿用 Nexus 现有行为：发送时切入数据子模式，两次发送之间恢复普通 FM 或 SSB，因此停留在 SSTV 呼叫信道时会反复退出数据模式。主动恢复是为了避免曾经出现的情况：SSTV 发送使调频中继台输入频率切入数据模式。但若整晚守听 SSTV 呼叫信道，这种恢复就不合适。返回话音操作前，请先停止接收器。离开 SSTV 页面后接收器仍会运行，电台也会保持数据子模式，此时发射音频来自数据端口，话筒无法产生调制。按电台分别设置，取决于接线和用途。

settings.rigControl.icomNative.hint.english: Nexus drives this Icom's CI-V directly instead of launching rigctld — unlocking the rig's real spectrum scope in the waterfall ("CI-V RF") and instant dial tracking. The scope needs 115200 baud, set the same on BOTH the radio and Nexus: (1) on the rig, Menu ▸ SET ▸ Connectors ▸ CI-V ▸ "CI-V USB Baud Rate" = 115200; (2) on the rig, same menu, "CI-V USB Port" = "Unlink from [REMOTE]"; (3) the Baud field above = 115200 to match. Below that the rig refuses to stream the scope (CAT still works; the panadapter just stays off). Save to apply; turn off any time to return to the classic Hamlib path.
settings.rigControl.icomNative.hint.chinese: Nexus 直接控制这台 Icom 的 CI-V，不再启动 rigctld，可在瀑布图中显示电台自身的射频频谱（“CI-V RF”），并即时跟随调谐频率。频谱功能要求电台和 Nexus 两端波特率均设为 115200：① 在电台 Menu ▸ SET ▸ Connectors ▸ CI-V 中，将“CI-V USB Baud Rate”设为 115200；② 在同一菜单中，将“CI-V USB Port”设为“Unlink from [REMOTE]”；③ 将上方波特率也设为 115200。低于此速率时，电台不传送频谱数据，CAT 仍可工作，但频谱显示不会开启。保存后生效，随时可关闭以恢复传统 Hamlib 方式。

settings.amplifier.follow.hint.english: Step the amplifier to the band you are on, without being asked. Off by default — this is the one amplifier control that acts on its own. settings.transmit.swrStop.hint.english: Two readings in a row above this and Nexus stops transmitting, exactly as Stop TX does, and tells you why. Its own audio goes out only once it has asked for a voice mode (USB, LSB, AM or FM). WSJT-X and JTDX ask for a mode only when it differs from Nexus's, so set to USB while Nexus is already in USB they ask for nothing and are refused. Every Nexus transmit safeguard still applies: TX must be on in Nexus, Stop TX wins and holds, and nothing goes past your licence or your power limits. A program never turns TX on. settings.msk144.period.hint.english: MSK144 sends a 72 ms message over and over, so a single meteor trail lasting a tenth of a second can carry the whole thing. Shorter periods turn the exchange around faster during a shower; longer ones give the decoder more frames to stack when pings are sparse. Both stations must use the same period.
settings.msk144.period.hint.chinese: MSK144 会反复发送一条时长 72 毫秒的报文，因此即使流星余迹只持续十分之一秒，也能传递完整报文。流星雨期间，较短周期有利于加快双方应答；反射信号零星时，较长周期可让解码器累积更多帧。双方必须使用相同周期。
settings.msk144.period.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.msk144.hint.english: MSK144 transmits for nearly the whole period, sending the same 72 ms frame hundreds of times — that is how meteor scatter works, and a contact can take many minutes of apparent silence. The audio frequency is fixed at a 1500 Hz centre; the signal is 1 kHz wide, so there is nowhere to tune it. Shorthand (MSK40) messages are off, matching WSJT-X’s default.
settings.msk144.hint.chinese: MSK144 几乎占用整个周期发射，将同一条 72 毫秒帧重复数百次，这是流星散射通联的工作方式；一次通联可能需要等待数分钟，期间听起来一片安静。音频中心频率固定为 1500 Hz，信号带宽为 1 kHz，因此无需调整音频频率。简短报文（MSK40）已关闭，与 WSJT-X 的默认设置一致。

settings.beacons.power.hint.english: Required, and it has to be real. WSPR reports are published to a public propagation database that other operators draw conclusions from, so a wrong figure corrupts their data as well as yours. settings.cw.keyer.hint.english: How Nexus sends CW. CAT uses the rig's internal keyer, but older rigs (e.g. IC-756PRO III) don't support it. Serial keyline toggles DTR/RTS into the rig's KEY jack (rig in CW, rig shapes the signal — a clean method that needs only a keying cable). WinKeyer drives a K1EL.Soundcard keys an audio tone — a workaround; set drive so ALC reads zero. It takes your radio out of CW into a data mode (DATA-U/DATA-L, so the tone reaches the transmitter instead of the mic jack); pick any other keyer and CW mode comes straight back. Also switchable live from the CW cockpit.
settings.cw.keyer.hint.chinese: 选择 Nexus 发送 CW 的方式。CAT 使用电台内部键控器，但较老的电台（如 IC-756PRO III）不支持。串口键控线 通过 DTR/RTS 控制电台的 KEY 电键插口（电台设为 CW，由电台完成信号整形，信号干净，仅需一根键控线）。WinKeyer 驱动 K1EL 硬件。声卡 通过音频音调键控，是一种变通方式；请将驱动电平调至 ALC 读数为零。此方式会让电台退出 CW，切换到数据模式（DATA-U/DATA-L，使音调进入发射通道而非话筒插口）；选择其他键控器后，会立即恢复 CW 模式。也可在 CW 操作界面中随时切换。

settings.cw.reverse.hint.english: Put your radio in its reverse CW mode (CW-R / CW-L) instead of its normal CW, on every band. Off by default, so Nexus asks for plain CW and your radio stays where its own menu puts it. This changes only the pitch you hear on a signal — CW and CW-R transmit identically, and the station you work cannot tell — so it is a personal preference, not a band rule. Which sideband it actually selects depends on the radio: on a Yaesu it is CW-L, while on an Icom it follows that rig's own CW Normal Side menu. The Soundcard keyer ignores this, because it never puts the rig in CW at all.
settings.cw.reverse.hint.chinese: 在所有频段让电台使用反向 CW 模式（CW-R / CW-L），而非常规 CW。默认关闭，此时 Nexus 请求普通 CW，实际侧带由电台自身菜单设置决定。这只改变接收信号的音调；CW 和 CW-R 的发射信号完全相同，对方无法分辨，因此这属于个人偏好，并非频段规则。实际选用哪个侧带取决于电台：Yaesu 使用 CW-L，Icom 则遵循电台自身的 CW Normal Side 菜单设置。声卡键控器会忽略此项，因为它根本不会将电台置于 CW 模式。

settings.rtty.backend.hint.english: How Nexus transmits RTTY. AFSK plays the two-tone waveform through the same TX audio path as FT8 (soundcard-clocked = jitter-free; set drive so ALC reads just zero). True FSK bit-bangs the rig's FSK input over a serial control line with the rig in RTTY mode — unlocking its narrow RTTY filters (e.g. the FTDX10's) — with PTT on CAT or its own line. Software FSK timing is casual/Field-Day grade; AFSK is the timing-cleanest path.
settings.rtty.backend.hint.chinese: 选择 Nexus 发送 RTTY 的方式。AFSK 通过与 FT8 相同的发射音频通道播放双音波形，由声卡时钟控制，无时序抖动；请将驱动电平调至 ALC 刚好为零。直接 FSK 将电台置于 RTTY 模式，通过串口控制线逐位驱动电台的 FSK 输入，从而可使用其窄带 RTTY 滤波器（如 FTDX10 的滤波器）；PTT 则通过 CAT 或独立控制线实现。软件 FSK 的时序精度适合日常通联及 Field Day 一类活动；AFSK 的时序最稳定。

settings.js8.hbIntervalMin.hint.english: 0 = a heartbeat only when you press HB. Otherwise, while the HB chip is on, one goes out every this-many minutes on a random free slot between 500 and 1000 Hz. The HB chip itself is never remembered across launches, and nothing keys unless TX is on.
settings.js8.hbIntervalMin.hint.chinese: 0 表示仅在按下 HB 时发送一次心跳。设为其他值时，若 HB 按钮处于开启状态，将每隔指定分钟数在 500 至 1000 Hz 之间随机选择一个空闲位置发送心跳。HB 按钮状态不会在重启应用后保留，只有 TX 开启时才会发射。
settings.js8.hbIntervalMin.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.cqIntervalMin.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.cqIntervalMin.hint.english: 0 = the CQ button sends one CQ, as it does today. Above 0 the button becomes a switch: leave it on and a CQ goes out every this-many minutes, with the seconds to the next one counting down on the button — the POTA and beacon habit. A station answering you turns it off, so does the idle watchdog, and so does Stop TX. It is never remembered across launches, and nothing keys unless TX is on.
settings.js8.cqIntervalMin.hint.chinese: 0 表示 CQ 按钮只发送一次 CQ，与原有行为相同。大于 0 时，按钮变为开关：保持开启便会每隔指定分钟数发送一次 CQ，按钮上显示距下次发送的倒计时，适合 POTA 活动及信标式呼叫。收到电台应答、触发空闲超时保护或按下“停止发射”时，都会关闭重复呼叫。此状态不会在重启应用后保留，只有 TX 开启时才会发射。
settings.js8.cqIntervalMin.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.hbAck.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.hbAck.hint.english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, a heard heartbeat is answered with your signal report (HEARTBEAT SNR), one frame per station, and a message you hold for that station is offered to it. Needs TX on.
settings.js8.hbAck.hint.chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，会用信号报告（HEARTBEAT SNR）应答收到的心跳，每台一帧；若有为该台代存的消息，也会通知对方领取。需要开启 TX。

settings.js8.hbAckDeny.label.english: Never acknowledge heartbeats from these callsigns
settings.js8.hbAckDeny.label.chinese: 不应答以下呼号的心跳
settings.js8.hbAckDeny.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.hbAckDeny.hint.english: Comma-separated, empty by default as in JS8Call. A heartbeat from a station on this list draws no acknowledgement.
settings.js8.hbAckDeny.hint.chinese: 呼号以逗号分隔，默认为空，与 JS8Call 一致。收到列表中电台的心跳时，不返回应答。

settings.js8.hbNetworking.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.hbNetworking.hint.english: Off by default, as in JS8Call (its Mode ▸ Enable Heartbeat Networking). On, the cockpit shows the HB button and Answer heartbeats can answer the heartbeats you hear; off, no heartbeat and no heartbeat acknowledgement goes out. The same switch as the cockpit’s HB NET.
settings.js8.hbNetworking.hint.chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 的“Mode ▸ Enable Heartbeat Networking”一致。开启后，操作界面会显示 HB 按钮，且启用“应答心跳”时可应答收到的心跳；关闭后，不发送心跳，也不发送心跳应答。与操作界面的 HB NET 开关控制同一设置。

settings.js8.hbAnywhere.label.chinese: 允许在 500–1000 Hz 范围外发送心跳
settings.js8.hbAnywhere.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.hbAnywhere.hint.english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, your heartbeats and heartbeat acknowledgements go out on your own TX offset. Off, each goes on a free spot between 500 and 1000 Hz, and a heartbeat stays on your offset if it is at or below 1000 Hz.
settings.js8.hbAnywhere.hint.chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，心跳和心跳应答使用本台当前发射频偏。关闭时，两者均在 500 至 1000 Hz 之间选择空闲位置发送；但若本台当前发射频偏不高于 1000 Hz，心跳会继续使用该频偏。

settings.js8.hbQsoPause.label.english: Pause heartbeats while a call is in the To box
settings.js8.hbQsoPause.label.chinese: “发给”框中有呼号时暂停心跳
settings.js8.hbQsoPause.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.hbQsoPause.hint.english: On by default, as in JS8Call (its pause while in a QSO). While the cockpit’s To box holds a call, the heartbeat repeat pauses and starts again one interval after you clear the box, no heartbeat is acknowledged, and a repeating CQ stops. Turning the heartbeat repeat on clears the To box.
settings.js8.hbQsoPause.hint.chinese: 默认开启，对应 JS8Call 的“QSO 期间暂停”设置。操作界面的“发给”框中有呼号时，重复心跳暂停，不应答心跳，并停止重复 CQ；清空该框后，经过一个心跳间隔才恢复重复心跳。开启重复心跳会清空“发给”框。
settings.js8.hbQsoPause.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.hbAckRateLimit.label.english: Don’t acknowledge stations that heartbeat more often than every 55 minutes
settings.js8.hbAckRateLimit.label.chinese: 不再应答心跳间隔短于 55 分钟的电台
settings.js8.hbAckRateLimit.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.hbAckRateLimit.hint.english: Off by default, as in JS8Call 3.0. On, a station heard heartbeating again within 55 minutes of its last acknowledged heartbeat is added to Never acknowledge heartbeats from these callsigns, as JS8Call adds it to its list, and the cockpit’s HB ACK chip names it. Take it off that list to acknowledge it again; turning this off leaves the list as it is.
settings.js8.hbAckRateLimit.hint.chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 3.0 一致。开启后，某台上次心跳获应答后 55 分钟内又发来心跳时，会像 JS8Call 一样，将该台加入“不应答以下呼号的心跳”列表，并在操作界面的 HB ACK 按钮上显示其呼号。将其从列表移除后才会恢复应答；关闭此选项不会清空该列表。
settings.js8.hbAckRateLimit.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.avoidAllcall.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.avoidAllcall.hint.english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, nothing addressed to @ALLCALL is answered (a QUERY MSGS included) or marked as addressed to you, and @ALLCALL leaves the To box’s list. Heartbeats and CQs are handled as before.
settings.js8.avoidAllcall.hint.chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，不应答任何发给 @ALLCALL 的报文（包括 QUERY MSGS），也不将其标记为发给本台；“发给”框的列表中也会移除 @ALLCALL。心跳和 CQ 仍按原有规则处理。
settings.js8.avoidAllcall.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.autoreply.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.autoreply.hint.english: On by default, as in JS8Call: SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, STATUS?, HEARING? and QUERY MSGS addressed to you are answered, and a MSG to you or to a group you joined, or a MSG TO: you hold for another station, gets an ACK; each one first asks for your Yes in the cockpit, unless you turn that off below. On @ALLCALL only QUERY MSGS is answered, when a message waits for that station, at most once every 15 minutes. Off, a reply is put in the message box for you to send, as JS8Call does, and QUERY MSGS is not answered. Needs TX on.
settings.js8.autoreply.hint.chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 一致：回复发给本台的 SNR?、GRID?、INFO?、STATUS?、HEARING? 和 QUERY MSGS；对于发给本台或已加入群组的 MSG，以及为其他电台代存的 MSG TO:，返回 ACK。每次都会先在操作界面请求你确认，除非关闭下方的确认选项。对于 @ALLCALL，只在有待该台领取的消息时回复 QUERY MSGS，且每 15 分钟最多一次。关闭时，会像 JS8Call 一样把回复放入报文输入框，由你发送，并且不回复 QUERY MSGS。需要开启 TX。
settings.js8.autoreply.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.autoreplyConfirmation.label.english: Ask for confirmation before sending automatic replies
settings.js8.autoreplyConfirmation.label.chinese: 发送自动回复前请求确认
settings.js8.autoreplyConfirmation.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.autoreplyConfirmation.hint.english: On by default, as in JS8Call: every automatic reply (to a query, an ACK, a relay, a heartbeat acknowledgement) waits in the cockpit for your Yes, and is not sent if you say No or do not answer within 89 seconds. Off, each goes by itself in the next period.
settings.js8.autoreplyConfirmation.hint.chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 一致：每次自动回复（查询应答、ACK、消息转发及心跳应答）都会在操作界面等待你确认；若拒绝或 89 秒内未确认，则不发送。关闭后，会在下一周期自动发送。
settings.js8.autoreplyConfirmation.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.autoreplyAllow.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.autoreplyAllow.hint.english: Comma-separated. Empty, the JS8Call default, answers everyone. Otherwise only a station on this list, by its call as heard or its base call (W1AW covers W1AW/P), is answered; anyone else is not acted on at all: no reply, no relay, nothing filed or held for them.
settings.js8.autoreplyAllow.hint.chinese: 呼号以逗号分隔。默认留空，与 JS8Call 一致，表示回复所有电台。填写后，仅回复所收到的呼号或基本呼号在列表中的电台（W1AW 也匹配 W1AW/P）；对其他电台完全不作处理：不回复、不转发，也不归档或代存消息。

settings.js8.autoreplyDeny.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.autoreplyDeny.hint.english: Comma-separated, empty by default as in JS8Call. A station on this list (W1AW covers W1AW/P) is not acted on at all: no reply, no relay, its message not filed.
settings.js8.autoreplyDeny.hint.chinese: 呼号以逗号分隔，默认为空，与 JS8Call 一致。对列表中的电台（W1AW 也匹配 W1AW/P）完全不作处理：不回复、不转发，也不归档其消息。
settings.js8.autoreplyDeny.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.relay.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.relay.hint.english: On by default, as in JS8Call: a message routed through your callsign is passed along (with Auto-reply off, it is put in the message box for you to send), and MSG TO: messages are held in your inbox until the addressee asks for them. This is third-party traffic — whether it is permitted where you operate is your call.
settings.js8.relay.hint.chinese: 默认开启，与 JS8Call 一致：经过本台呼号路由的消息会继续转发；若关闭自动回复，则先放入报文输入框，由你发送。MSG TO: 消息会代存在收件箱，直到收件人请求领取。这属于第三方通信，请自行判断当地规定是否允许。
settings.js8.relay.hint.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.idleWatchdogMin.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.idleWatchdogMin.hint.english: After this long with nothing typed, heartbeats, auto-replies and relaying all switch off and the cockpit says so — the JS8Call rule, so an unattended station goes quiet. 60 by default; 0 turns the watchdog off; anything below 5 counts as 5. TX enable is left as it was.
settings.js8.idleWatchdogMin.hint.chinese: 超过指定时间未输入文字后，会关闭心跳、自动回复和转发，并在操作界面提示。这遵循 JS8Call 的规则，使无人值守的电台停止自动发送。默认为 60 分钟，0 表示关闭保护，非零且小于 5 的值按 5 分钟处理。TX 启用状态保持原样。

settings.js8.info.hint.chinese: 回复 INFO? 查询的内容，例如电台设备、天线、功率或 QTH。大写字母、数字和基本标点的编码最紧凑，其他字符会占用更多报文帧。

settings.js8.groups.hint.chinese: 填写你加入的 @GROUP 群组名，以逗号分隔；发给其中任一群组的消息都视为发给本台。@ALLCALL 代表所有人，始终启用。

settings.js8.holdPtt.hint.english: Off by default, as in JS8Call. On, the radio stays keyed from the end of one frame of a message until the next frame starts, instead of dropping PTT after each frame and keying again. PTT still drops after the last frame, and at once when you stop transmitting.
settings.js8.holdPtt.hint.chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致。开启后，同一报文的一帧结束至下一帧开始之间，电台保持发射，不再逐帧释放并重新触发 PTT。最后一帧结束后仍会释放 PTT；手动停止发射时也会立即释放。

settings.js8.txOffsetWhileSending.label.english: Allow TX offset changes while sending
settings.js8.txOffsetWhileSending.label.chinese: 允许发送期间更改发射频偏
settings.js8.txOffsetWhileSending.label.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

settings.js8.txOffsetWhileSending.hint.english: Off by default, as in JS8Call: while a message is waiting to go or going out, the TX offset stays where it is. On, you can move it at once: the frame on the air moves too, from where it has got to, and the frames still to go are sent at the new offset.
settings.js8.txOffsetWhileSending.hint.chinese: 默认关闭，与 JS8Call 一致：报文等待发送或正在发送期间，发射频偏固定不变。开启后可立即调整，当前正在发射的帧会从当前进度起移至新频偏，后续帧也会在新频偏上发送。

settings.js8.txDelay.hint.english: How long before each period a JS8 frame keys the radio, as JS8Call's Tx delay (0.2 s by default). The frame's first tone still goes out on time, at the period's start delay, so a radio slow to key no longer sends it late. Lengthen it for an amplifier or a radio whose relay is slow.
settings.js8.txDelay.hint.chinese: 设置每个 JS8 帧在周期到来前提前多久触发电台发射，对应 JS8Call 的 Tx delay（默认 0.2 秒）。帧的首个音调仍会按该周期的起始延时准时发出，避免电台切换发射较慢导致报文迟发。使用功放或继电器动作较慢的电台时，可增大此值。

settings.integrations.clusterSsid.hint.english: Added to your callsign at login (2 = W9XYZ-2). A node allows one session per callsign and drops the older one, so a second Nexus — or another cluster program on the same call — knocks this one off unless each uses a different SSID. 1-99, or leave it empty to log in with your bare call. Your spots still reach the network under your plain callsign. On a node that requires registration, register the suffixed call there too or it will not let you post spots. Takes effect on the next Save.
settings.integrations.clusterSsid.hint.chinese: 登录时附加到本台呼号之后（例如 2 表示 W9XYZ-2）。节点通常只允许每个呼号保持一个会话，新连接会挤掉旧连接；因此另一份 Nexus 或使用同一呼号的集群软件会使此连接掉线，除非各自使用不同 SSID。可填 1–99，留空则使用无后缀呼号登录。发布的通报仍以原始呼号进入网络。若节点要求注册，还须在该节点注册带后缀的呼号，否则无法发布通报。下次保存后生效。

settings.confirmations.lotw.adifLocation.english: Turn on if you set TQSL to "use the location in the ADIF file" and don't create named Station Locations (handy if you travel). Nexus then stamps your call + grid (STATION_CALLSIGN / MY_GRIDSQUARE) into the upload and omits the -l argument, so TQSL signs from those and the Station Location above isn't required. The whole batch is signed from your current grid above, so if you operate from more than one location, upload before you move — otherwise earlier contacts are signed with the new grid.
settings.confirmations.lotw.adifLocation.chinese: 若已在 TQSL 中选择“使用 ADIF 文件中的位置”，且不创建具名的 Station Location，可开启此项，便于异地操作。Nexus 会将本台呼号和网格（STATION_CALLSIGN / MY_GRIDSQUARE）写入上传文件，并省略 -l 参数，让 TQSL 据此签名，无需填写上方电台位置。整批记录都使用上方当前网格签名，因此若会在多个地点操作，请在移动之前上传，否则此前的交信也会使用新网格签名。

settings.dataFolder.note.english: Your logbook, the data tables Nexus downloads and the Winlink mailbox live in one folder. Keep it on a drive inside this computer. Nexus keeps your logbook in a database, and a database on a network drive can be damaged by the way file locking works across a network, so a network drive is refused. A synced folder (Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud, Google Drive) is allowed, but only ONE Nexus may use it at a time: two computers writing one logbook through a sync client make a conflicted copy, not a merged log.
settings.dataFolder.note.chinese: 日志、Nexus 下载的数据表和 Winlink 邮箱都保存在同一文件夹中，请放在本机内部磁盘上。Nexus 使用数据库保存日志，网络文件锁的工作方式可能导致网络盘上的数据库损坏，因此不允许使用网络盘。可以使用 Dropbox、OneDrive、iCloud 或 Google Drive 同步文件夹，但同一时间只能由一个 Nexus 使用；两台电脑经同步客户端同时写同一日志，只会产生冲突副本，不会合并日志。

Copy the folder to a drive inside this computer and point Nexus at the copy.

aprs.health.unreadable.detail.english: {{count}} bursts heard since arming, last one {{age}} ago — none passed the checksum. Some of that is normal: when the squelch opens partway through a burst the start of the packet is lost, and a part-heard packet can never pass. It is only a fault if nothing ever decodes — in which case check the rig is on {{channel}} in FM.{{advice}} Last burst peaked {{burst}}; live {{level}}.
aprs.health.unreadable.detail.chinese: 启用后收到 {{count}} 段突发信号，最近一段在 {{age}} 前，均未通过校验。部分失败属于正常现象：若静噪在突发信号中途才打开，就会丢失包头，收到的不完整数据包不可能通过校验。只有始终无法解码时才说明有问题，此时请确认电台位于 {{channel}} 并使用 FM。{{advice}} 最近突发峰值：{{burst}}；当前电平：{{level}}。
aprs.health.unreadable.detail.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

aprs.health.advice.clipping.english: The burst is CLIPPING (peaked {{peak}}, {{samples}} sample(s) at the rails) — lower the rig's USB AF output level, or the Windows input level for that device. Packet survives a lot of clipping, so this costs headroom rather than decodes, but there is no reason to run into the rails.
aprs.health.advice.clipping.chinese: 突发信号发生削波，峰值 {{peak}}，{{samples}} 个采样达到幅度极限。请降低电台的 USB AF 输出电平，或该设备的 Windows 输入电平。分组信号能容忍较严重的削波，因此这主要损失电平余量，不一定影响解码，但没有必要让信号持续顶到幅度极限。
aprs.health.advice.clipping.reviewMethod: 模型语义校对；源码上下文与第三方术语资料比对

aprs.health.advice.quiet.english: The burst peaked {{peak}}, well below the healthy {{min}} to {{max}} band — raise the rig's USB AF output level (IC-9700: SET > Connectors > USB AF Output Level) or the Windows input level for that device. That buys margin against noise; it is not by itself why a checksum fails.
aprs.health.advice.quiet.chinese: 突发峰值为 {{peak}}，远低于建议的 {{min}} 至 {{max}} 范围。请提高电台 USB AF 输出电平（IC-9700：SET > Connectors > USB AF Output Level），或该设备的 Windows 输入电平。这能增加抗噪余量，但电平低本身并非校验失败的原因。

aprs.health.silent.detail.english: The input is alive and delivering audio, but it is silent — normally that just means the squelch is closed between packets, which is what an idle FM channel looks like. To confirm the routing, open the squelch: hiss should show up here as a level. If it still reads silent with the squelch open, the wrong input device is selected. Live {{level}}.

operate.dxped.hound.title.english: DXpedition hound: calls go out above 1000 Hz, your R+report auto-moves to the Fox's frequency, and the QSO ends on the Fox's RR73 with NO parting 73 — a 73 there is QRM in the Fox's own segment.
